raw.description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

About the Role

The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations / Project Manager with a strong AdTech Background to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

The Business Operations / Project Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

Core Responsibilities

1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

  • Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.


2. Project Management & Visibility

  • Own and maintain internal Notion project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond the department, building the systems foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into business line weekly meetings, as aligned with product operating model.


3. Product Rollout Support

  • Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with Group Product Manager to formalize this process as a repeatable model.


4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

  • Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.


5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

  • Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for departmental initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable, and scalable systems and models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role.

Who You Are

  • The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
  • The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
  • Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
  • Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.


What We Offer

  • True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for Anaplan’s Technology and ISV partnerships, identifying new market opportunities, enabling go-to-market teams, and driving joint sales execution alongside our Technology partners and Systems Integrator partners (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture, EY).

You will help shape differentiated solutions and market offerings, influence product collaboration and sales activation, and ensure field teams are equipped to drive meaningful customer outcomes. Success in this role will come through building executive-level partnerships, leveraging data-driven insights to optimize investment and ROI, and fostering alignment across internal and external stakeholders to accelerate growth and long-term strategic value.

  • Build and scale our technology partnerships across the Data, Cloud, AI, and ISV ecosystems.

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Engagement Manager at Chooose, you will partner with our enterprise customers in the aviation and energy sectors, enabling them to build and operate their SAF programs. In close collaboration with the Chooose Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest customers in your assigned region, supporting customers across their entire experience with the Chooose platform, from implementation to solution go-live and beyond.
This is a remote role that must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida
Alt ID: Strategic Account Manager / Client Partner / Engagement Manager / Enterprise CSM / Strategic Account Lead

What you'll do

  • Own total responsibility for a portfolio of key enterprise customers within the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors.
  • Become the expert on the customer's SAF program. Thoroughly understand the customer’s program objectives, and guide how the customer leverages the Chooose platform to reach these objectives.
  • Cultivate high-trust relationships with key stakeholders across our customer organizations (from Sustainability to Fuel Procurement) and function as the customer's trusted advisor.
  • Drive customer success. Assess, clarify, and validate customer needs and new commercial expansion opportunities on an ongoing basis. Proactively qualify and champion these needs and opportunities internally, with an emphasis on gathering and delivering structured product feedback.
  • Maintain a balanced approach and multiple perspectives. Enable commercial growth while considering Chooose's commitment to enabling long-term, high-integrity climate action.
  • Manage complex software deployments. Supported by an assigned Technical Implementation Manager and other key resources, oversee the implementation of complex decarbonization programs including a range of climate solutions from Sustainable Aviation Fuel to carbon offsets and removals.
  • Refine our playbook. Drive continuous improvement across Technical Implementation, Customer Operations, and Customer Success functions.
  • Collaborate with multiple Chooose teams to execute the operational tasks needed to achieve program objectives on time and with high quality.
  • Proactively and continually educate yourself on the carbon-related requirements and market trends impacting our customers and the sectors in which we operate.

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise project management, or similar.
  • Experience in enterprise software organizations relating to carbon markets, fuel markets, or carbon accounting is a plus.
  • Technical capability. You enjoy helping customers solve business and technical problems, and are comfortable with technical and highly configurable SaaS solutions. Previous experience with API integrations and enterprise-grade SaaS solutions is a plus.
  • You listen carefully and authentically care about solving customer problems.
  • Polished presentation skills and are comfortable discussing technical and commercial topics with external stakeholders.
  • Self-directed problem solver who takes initiative
  • Flexible with work hours for global customer support.
  • You're willing to be flexible with your work hours to support your colleagues and accommodate our global customers.
  • You’re open to frequent travel on short notice.
  • You have superior verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Spanish is a plus.
  • Must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will involve a practical exercise for you to show your work. You’ll receive written instructions for the exercise in advance, and we’ll then schedule a time to discuss. The third and final phase consists of a one-on-one conversation with a member of our executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

- Commission-only. You earn 30% of everything a customer you bring pays us in their first 12 months, rising to 35% and then 40% as you close more.

- Full access to the product, a demo property, recorded walkthroughs and a deck.

raw.description:
About Flowmingo AI

Flowmingo is a Y Combinator-backed startup (plus VinaCapital & top global investors) on a mission to democratize hiring. We believe the current hiring model is broken: recruiters only have time to interview 5% of applicants, leaving 95% of talent—the "hidden gems"—undiscovered. We are fixing this with an AI-native, high-volume interviewing platform. Our model is unique: we offer our tool for free to recruiters to capture the massive, uncontested markets of Southeast Asia, LATAM, and Africa. This allows us to process massive volumes of candidates that traditional, expensive platforms cannot touch.

About the Role: Product Intern / Fresher

Join a YC-backed AI hiring startup and help shape the future of AI collaboration. As a Product Intern/Fresher, your primary focus will be on understanding and optimizing the "User Journey." Our platform serves thousands of candidates daily, and your mission will be to delve into their motivations and behaviors: Why do they sign up? Where do they encounter friction? How can we enhance the product's value to transform users into advocates?

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Ideation & Strategy: Contribute to brainstorming and strategic discussions, identifying user pain points and proposing new features that drive growth and engagement.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Engineering on feasibility, Marketing on launch messaging, and Operations to understand real-time user feedback.

  • Funnel Optimization: Analyze data to identify areas for improvement in the user journey. For example, investigate why only 40% of users complete their profile and propose strategies to increase this to 60%.

  • Feature Specifications & Documentation: Write clear, concise requirements for new features and assist in maintaining the product roadmap.

  • Product Testing (QA): Test new features before launch to ensure a polished user experience and identify any bugs.

  • Launch Management: Help coordinate feature releases, ensuring alignment across Marketing, Operations, and Technology teams for successful rollouts.

What We're Looking For

  • Data-Driven Intuition: You can use data to inform decisions while maintaining empathy for user psychology.

  • Clear Communicator: You can explain complex ideas simply and write concise requirements.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You are interested in how products grow from inception to scale. You are eager to learn about Product-Led Growth (PLG) and viral loops.

  • Design Sensibility: While not a designer, you have a good sense of what constitutes a "clean" and "trustworthy" user interface.

  • Bonus: A strong interest in tech products, data analytics, or coding. Curiosity about how software is built is a significant plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Remuneration: Monthly compensation will be provided, tailored to your experience level.

  • Startup Scaling Insights: Gain direct insights into how YC-backed Silicon Valley startups build and scale products.

  • Real Impact: See your ideas implemented and directly influence the user experience for thousands.

  • Mentorship: Work closely with the Founder and the Product team.

How to Apply

Ready to make an impact? Apply now!

We review applications on a rolling basis. In your application, demonstrate your understanding of user behavior and motivation.

Location: Remote (Global)

Employment type: Internship → Full-time

Compensation: Stipend + potential full-time offer

raw.excerpt: We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing (Paid Media & Tracking) to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms.
raw.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing (Paid Media & Tracking) to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

Job Title: Senior Migration Consultant - Clinical Data Programming

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva's Vault Clinical Data Management System (CDMS) is changing how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data, bringing EDC, coding, and Data Quality System (DQS) together in one platform. The Migration Team works within this group, focusing on migrating customers off legacy systems—such as Medidata Rave and Oracle InForm—into Vault CDMS.

We are looking for a Senior Migration Consultant with hands-on experience programming and processing extremely large clinical datasets. In this full-time, customer-facing role, you will serve as a trusted, customer-facing technical lead, partnering directly with Sponsors throughout active migration programs.

What You’ll Do

    • Partner directly with Sponsors and CROs to interpret legacy clinical database structures, protocol specifications, and data mapping requirements, applying Veeva migration best practices.
    • Perform data transformation, mapping, and script validation on large, complex clinical datasets extracted from legacy platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm).
    • Lead end-to-end data migration delivery across complex, active clinical trials per the project plan, coordinating closely with cross-functional technical teams.
    • Develop and configure validation scripts, and custom SQL-based listings to ensure data integrity, auditability, and cleanliness during ingestion into Veeva DQS and Vault CDMS.
    • Provide feedback to the Vault CDMS & DQS product teams based on real-world customer migration challenges, data volume bottlenecks, and client requirements.
    • Contribute to reusable migration tools, data mapping templates, and automation initiatives, mentoring junior team members throughout the migration lifecycle.

Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience with EDC clinical software, covering end-to-end data management (database design, data collection, data analysis, query resolution, datasets, statistical reporting)
    • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes, particularly around data collection and review
    • Programming experience in languages such as SAS, R, Python, or SQL, with the ability to pick up new SQL-based languages
    • Background in the life sciences industry (pharma, biotech, medical device, CRO, or academic/public health), with experience across project assessment, planning, development, training, and implementation
    • Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within software professional services or consulting
    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while meeting project timelines
    • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
    • Willingness to travel up to 10%, potentially including international travel

Nice to Have

    • Knowledge of DBT
    • Familiarity with data management standards (GCDMP, CDISC, SDTMIG, CDASH, ADaM)
    • Experience working with system integrators for IVRS, medical coding, eSource, CTMS, eTMF, or similar clinical technologies
    • Experience integrating or programming with REST-based APIs
    • Experience translating clinical protocols into software specifications, including technical documentation
    • Experience with Veeva applications
    • Located near a major life sciences hub
    • Degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field

Interview with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $100,000 - 160,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

You'll find your choice of career opportunities, great benefits, an environment that welcomes and values creativity, and a work experience that is both challenging and rewarding!

The ability to measure and evaluate the impact of public relations efforts is critical to ensuring the success of any marketing and/or public relations campaign. In the Social Media Metrics and ROI course, students will learn how to track, report, and analyze a variety of metrics that describe audience behavior and attitudes. In the course, students will learn how to use numeric information to describe and explain performance in relation to campaign goals and objectives. Students will examine quantitative and qualitative measurements to help provide context for audience search trends, website traffic, and social behavior such as sharing content. In addition to exploring these metrics, students will also learn how to integrate these measures into their professional planning. The course will provide students with an understanding of both traditional and contemporary metrics and reporting tools for analyzing data. Ultimately, students will learn how to develop and create reports, which will develop a stakeholder's understanding and confidence in the public relations process. This position is part time working no more than 20 hours per week, online and must be resident in the state of Florida.

Community Boost is seeking a Performance Marketing Manager who is equal parts client strategist, media buyer and technical executor in Google/Meta ads. In this role, you will be the primary strategic partner for a dedicated portfolio of small size nonprofit clients. This role reports to the Director of Client Services and is responsible for the holistic health of the client relationship—leading the conversation, designing the roadmap, and personally executing the media buying that brings that roadmap to life. This role is a REMOTE POSITION and can be anywhere in the US.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Consulting: Act as the lead advisor for a portfolio of nonprofit partners. Identify growth opportunities, troubleshoot organizational challenges, and align digital tactics with long-term fundraising goals.
  • Client Relationship Management: Lead all client-facing communications for 15 clients, including monthly strategy sessions and performance deep-dives.
  • Full-Stack Channel Execution: Own the hands-on execution and optimization across major platforms including Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, PMAX, Grant). Perform weekly account health checks to refine bidding, audiences, ad creative, and campaign structures to maximize ROAS and CPA targets.
  • Narrative Reporting: You know how to move beyond "vanity metrics." and be able to articulate the why behind performance trends to Marketing Directors and Nonprofit Boards.
  • Omnichannel Strategy & Attribution: Drive integrated strategies across multiple channels (Paid Search, Social, Programmatic). Utilize advanced attribution concepts (multi-touch, LTV, incrementality) to provide a holistic view using GA4 and Ninjacat to track how channels drive donor acquisition and long-term value.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Develop and implement a disciplined testing framework, including monthly hypotheses, recommended variants, implementation, and reporting on results to maximize on-page conversions.
  • Project Management: Maintaining project management using Asana and Basecamp, and ensuring all client deliverables are met on time without internal oversight.

Qualifications

  • Deep Channel Expertise (Required): Primary experience must be in Google Ads Grant and Meta Ads Manager, with a strong background in other paid media such as Programmatic (Display) and video (YouTube). You must be comfortable jumping between high-level cross-channel strategy and granular platform optimizations.
  • Agency Experience (Required): 3-5 years in a fast-paced agency environment, managing client relationships and significant media spend simultaneously.
  • Nonprofit Sector Knowledge: Experience working with nonprofits is highly preferred with an understanding of donor psychology, the "giving season," and nonprofit budget constraints.

Required Skills

  • Client Presentation Mastery: Proven track record of leading meetings and presenting complex strategies to senior-level stakeholders with confidence.
  • The Consultant Mindset: Proactive rather than reactive. You anticipate client needs and bring new ideas to the table before being asked.
  • Time Management: Consistently meets deadlines by organizing tasks, managing priorities, and avoiding last-minute scrambles. Demonstrates reliability in day-to-day execution.
  • Attention to Detail: Delivers polished, error-free work by catching inconsistencies and ensuring accuracy across all deliverables. Maintains high standards even under pressure.
  • Written Communication: Writes clearly and professionally, adapting tone and format to suit internal and client audiences. Avoids ambiguity and ensures messages are easy to understand.
  • Team Collaboration: Works well with others by sharing information, supporting teammates, and contributing to a positive team dynamic. Builds trust through dependability and openness.
  • Project Management: Plans and executes projects with clear timelines, milestones, and accountability. Keeps stakeholders informed and ensures deliverables are met.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by the person assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Community Boost reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary to meet business needs. Employment is at-will unless otherwise specified in a written employment agreement.

As a Senior Clinical Data Engineer, you will drive the strategic design and implementation of data management solutions that enable efficient clinical trial operations and regulatory compliance. This position plays a critical role in managing data ingestion, quality assurance, and reporting infrastructure that supports study execution and patient safety. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including project managers, biostatisticians, and regulatory specialists to deliver first-time-quality data solutions.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through leading technical innovation, mentoring emerging talent, and establishing best practices in clinical data management. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Clinical Data Engineer can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research, data engineering, and regulatory science.

Key Responsibilities

  • Comfort working with multiple data management systems and technologies, with the ability to quickly master new tools and adapt to evolving technical landscapes
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and innovation in clinical trial operations

raw.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Growth & Experimentation
raw.excerpt: Everis has a different standard for talent.  We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability.
raw.description:
Everis has a different standard for talent. We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability. We look for exceptional work, sound judgment, fast learning, ownership, and evidence of impact. It is not a lower bar. It is a sharper one.

We’re looking for an accomplished software engineer who has built real mobile applications and already has practical exposure to growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or broader product work. This role requires both engineering depth and evidence that you can think beyond implementation.

Join Everis at a defining stage of growth. Help shape the product, influence the company we become, and grow with us. Work 100% remotely from anywhere, benefit from unlimited leave, and connect with colleagues at company-sponsored international retreats in some of the world’s most inspiring cities.

About Everis

Everis is a growing, remote-first software company founded by proven technology entrepreneurs Rob Rawson and Liam Martin, who previously built Time Doctor into an eight-figure global SaaS business. We acquire promising mobile apps and SaaS companies, invest in their future, and improve their products, technology, and customer experience. Our ambition is to make Everis the best long-term home for exceptional software products—and a company where exceptional people can take real ownership, do consequential work, and grow with us.

About the Product

Pebble is Everis’s growing, speaking-first language-learning app for iOS and Android. It helps people learn English, Spanish, and French through practical lessons, pronunciation practice, and guided conversations that get them speaking from day one. The product is live and evolving quickly, with major opportunities across onboarding, habit formation, activation, retention, conversion, and new markets. Your engineering and product decisions will directly influence how well people learn and how quickly Pebble grows.

What makes this role different

Most engineering roles begin after the problem, solution, and ticket have already been defined. Here, you join the work earlier. You will remain a software engineer first, but you will also identify product problems, decide what to test, build the solution, measure the outcome, and use the evidence to determine what happens next. This is not a marketing role for someone who codes; it is an engineering role with responsibility for product outcomes.

What you’ll work on

  • Build, ship, and improve Pebble’s mobile applications.

  • Find friction across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization.

  • Turn product questions into improvements, prototypes, A/B tests, and other useful experiments.

  • Use product and user data to understand behavior and decide what should be built next.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, and act on what you learn.

  • Work directly with our founders and product and business leadership.

  • Balance strong engineering with the speed required to test ideas and learn.

What you need to bring

This is a mobile engineering job first. You need to have built, shipped, and supported a production mobile app. We mean a real product used by real people - not just a demo or code sample.

We also need proof you've thought beyond implementation. Show us at least one of these:

  • Breadth beyond implementation. Direct mobile-growth or conversion work You must show meaningful evidence of at least one of the following: growth experimentation, A/B or split testing, conversion optimization, product ownership, building and operating your own software product.

  • Conversion optimization. You improved a real flow: onboarding, activation, a paywall, trial-to-paid, checkout, or another point where users dropped.

  • Core Stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment about reliability, maintainability, quality, and speed. Flutter/Dart, TypeScript/NestJS, MongoDB, or close equivalents; and App Store or Google Play subscriptions, paywalls, payments, or trial-to-paid journeys.

  • Production mobile engineering. Demonstrated success building and shipping production mobile applications using iOS, Android, cross-platform, or another credible mobile environment.

  • Product development or ownership. You helped decide what to build and why. You didn't just receive a finished specification. You can independently take production software from problem through implementation, release, and iteration.

  • Product-management-type work. You framed the problem, made trade-offs, defined success, or used evidence to choose the next move.

  • A product of your own. You built it, launched it, watched real people use it, and changed it based on what you learned.

What good looks like

  • Your fundamentals are solid. APIs, data modelling, testing, debugging, release practices, and production monitoring aren't someone else's job.

  • You can tell the whole story. What was wrong, what you personally built, what happened, and what you did next.

  • You cross boundaries when the problem demands it. Mobile, backend, web, data, analytics - you don't stop at the edge of your code.

  • You'd rather find out than argue from theory. You form a view, test it, and change your mind when the evidence says you should.

What we offer

  • Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 USD annually, depending on experience.

  • Consequential ownership: your decisions will directly affect Pebble and Everis.

  • Direct founder access: work closely with experienced entrepreneurs on important product and company decisions.

  • Exceptional colleagues: work with capable, curious, high-ownership people held to the same demanding standard.

  • Room to grow: take on larger problems and greater responsibility as Everis expands.

  • 100% remote: work from anywhere.

  • Unlimited leave: take meaningful time away when you need it.

  • Paid international company trips: come together with the team in some of the world’s most inspiring cities—to collaborate, build lasting relationships, and experience somewhere new.

Our recruiting process

We keep our process structured and transparent:

  • Initial review: Application → Written Assessment

  • Skills and reasoning: Recorded Scenario Assessment → Reasoning Intelligence Test → Recorded Role-Specific Assessment

  • Interviews: Technical Interview → Final Interview with a Co-Founder

  • Final evaluation: Paid Work Trial

If you are an exceptional mobile engineer who wants to help decide what gets built, prove whether it works, and shape a growing product, we want to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $80K - $120K

Overview:

Sentara is hiring a Senior Data Analyst!

This position is fully remote.

Overview

The Senior Data Analyst supports the Batch Reprocessing and Payment Integrity function by designing and delivering the reporting, dashboards, and analytical tooling that measure operational performance across the claims reprocessing lifecycle. Working across multiple claims adjudication platforms and the team's ticketing and data warehouse environments, this role turns raw claims and workflow data into reliable metrics on cycle time, turnaround, recovery volume, and queue health. The Senior Data Analyst partners with operations leadership to define complex reporting requirements, builds repeatable and auditable data pulls in place of manual one-off extracts, and contributes to data quality and stewardship so the team's operational numbers hold up under leadership and audit review. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone fluent in SQL and claims data, not a generalist business intelligence position.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst is the analytics owner for a healthcare claims reprocessing and payment integrity team operating across two health plan markets. The team handles overpayment recovery, claims reprocessing, provider contestment review, and the operational reporting that supports each. This role builds and maintains the data products the team and its leadership rely on to manage day-to-day work and to demonstrate performance against operational targets.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain operational dashboards and reports that track reprocessing cycle time, post-approval turnaround, queue and hold status, stalled or aging tickets, contestment volume, and recovery throughput.

• Write and optimize complex SQL against multiple claims adjudication systems and an enterprise data platform, including queries that join claims data to ticketing and workflow data through established crosswalks.

• Replace manual, ad-hoc extracts with documented, repeatable, and parameterized data pulls so that recurring reports are consistent and reproducible from one period to the next.

• Translate operational questions from team leadership into clear reporting requirements, and document those requirements so the logic behind each metric is transparent and defensible.

• Conduct ad-hoc analysis to answer time-sensitive operational and prioritization questions, including high-dollar case identification and workload distribution across reviewers and analysts.

• Support data quality and stewardship efforts: validate that source data ties out, identify and document data gaps or anomalies, and flag conditions that would make a metric unreliable before it reaches leadership.

• Partner with IT and data platform teams on data access, source structure, and the migration of operational data off manual processes onto governed, auditable platforms.

• Produce reporting that is appropriate for a regulated, audited environment, including clear sourcing and documentation of report logic, while keeping the role's outputs limited to operational status and analytics rather than financial estimates or accounting determinations.

• Promote self-service reporting where appropriate by building reusable, well-documented data products rather than serving every request as a one-off.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. (Required)

Certification/Licensure

  • Relevant certification such as a coding credential (CPC), a Microsoft data or Power BI certification, or a SQL or database certification.

Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive data analysis experience, with at least two years working directly with healthcare claims, payer operations, or payment integrity data. (Required)
  • Demonstrated experience writing production-grade SQL against relational databases independently, not solely through a drag-and-drop reporting layer. (Required)
  • Advanced SQL, Data visualization and BI development, with hands-on Power BI experience
  • Python coding, data warehouse using Synapse
  • Exposure to workflow or ticketing systems and to joining workflow data to claims data.
  • Ability to gather and document reporting requirements and to explain the logic behind a metric to a non-technical operations audience.
  • Data Quality, Data Validation experience
  • Experience working with IT and Data teams
  • Experience with a claims adjudication platform (QNXT, Facets, or a comparable payer system) and with claims data structures such as claim, line, member eligibility, provider, and coordination of benefits.
  • Familiarity with operating in an ICFR or SOX regulated environment and producing reporting that supports audit and control requirements.
  • Familiarity with or hands-on use of AI and large language model tools

Talroo

Keywords: Data Analysis, SQL, Data visualization, BI, Python, Synapse, claims adjudication, data quality, QNXT, Facets, payer claim, ICFR, SOX, healthcare data analysis, payment integrity, payer operations, healthcare claim, data validation

raw.excerpt: About Scaling. comScaling. com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less.
raw.description:
About Scaling.com

Scaling.com helps established business owners 10x their companies in three years or less. We work with entrepreneurs doing $1 million or more in revenue who are ready to stop being the bottleneck and build a company that scales. Our creative library includes books, podcasts, keynotes, live events, member interviews, case studies, trainings, webinars, founder content, and years of verified customer stories.

Why This Role Exists

Scaling.com tests hundreds of paid hooks each week. When a hook or angle proves it can earn attention, you will turn it into a family of visual concepts for paid static ads. We are looking for a designer who has already produced conversion-focused creative at the volume and quality required to support multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

You will receive a winning hook or developed angle. You are not waiting for a finished layout. Your job is to decide how the idea should be visualized, which evidence or source material strengthens it, and how to create multiple distinct concepts that can be tested quickly.

This is one high-ownership in-house role, not a contractor-management position and not a brand-polish role.

Requirements

Your Core Workflow

Receive a winning hook, proven ad, or developed angle from the creative strategy team, along with winners, losers, hook data, creative references, and testing requests supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team.

  • Understand why it worked and what the visual must communicate in the first second.
  • Use AI to search our content and proof library for relevant testimonials, founder material, book passages, customer stories, screenshots, frameworks, podcast moments, event excerpts, and visual references.
  • Develop several genuinely different visual concepts before polishing one direction. Continually contribute original concepts, competitor references, visual devices, and new test ideas to the team's shared concept pool.
  • Design paid statics around books, highlighted passages, frameworks, customer proof, founder material, screenshots, UGC-style assets, photography, and original visual metaphors.
  • Create meaningful variations across headline, hierarchy, composition, image choice, proof, framing, CTA, and visual hook.
  • Use AI to accelerate research, composition exploration, image cleanup, controlled asset generation, and repetitive production while retaining human control over the concept and final craft.
  • Ship clean, editable Figma files and platform-ready exports.
  • Review the winners, losers, hook data, and performance feedback supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team, then turn the learning into new visual families.

What You Own

  • Visual concepting
  • Hook visualization
  • AI-assisted research
  • Proof visualization
  • Static ad design
  • Typography and hierarchy
  • Image and asset creation
  • Meaningful variations
  • Figma organization
  • Quality control
  • Winner iteration
  • Performance learning

What Your Day Actually Looks Like

  • Review winners, losers, hook data, creative references, and testing directions supplied by our Head of Content and paid-media team.
  • Select an approved hook or developed angle and generate several distinct visual approaches.
  • Search the content library with AI for the strongest supporting proof and imagery.
  • Build net-new concepts with disciplined hierarchy, typography, imagery, credibility, and platform-safe composition.
  • Create useful variations that isolate a real hypothesis.
  • Inspect legibility at feed size, source accuracy, visual artifacts, alignment, export settings, and file structure.
  • Use the supplied results and team analysis to build the next visual family from what worked.

What Success Looks Like

  • A proven hook becomes several distinct, testable visual concepts rather than one layout with color changes.
  • The idea reads immediately and the visual earns attention without cheapening trust.
  • Proof remains legible, accurate, and credible for a sophisticated business audience.
  • AI expands useful research and output without replacing design judgment.
  • Winning concepts are recombined and extended as the paid-media team scales them.
  • Editable files remain organized for rapid reuse and iteration.

What We Need to See

A portfolio of conversion-oriented paid ads with measurable outcomes such as spend, qualified leads, CTR, conversion, booked calls, revenue, or lift against a control. Your past work should demonstrate the volume, quality, and judgment required to sustain multiple millions of dollars in monthly ad spend.

  • Strong typography, hierarchy, composition, image craft, and concept range across more than one visual style.
  • Personal ownership of the concepts and editable files you show.
  • Experience designing for a sophisticated or high-consideration audience where credibility matters as much as stopping power.
  • A testing example that explains the hook, visual hypothesis, variants, controlled differences, result, and next decision.
  • A repeatable AI-enabled Figma or design workflow with a finished example and credible impact on speed or output.

This Role Is Not

  • An organic social designer
  • A brand-only portfolio role
  • A production artist waiting for layouts
  • Template swapping at volume
  • AI imagery without design
  • A contractor-management position
  • Beauty without response

How to Apply

Choose one paid static campaign you personally designed. Explain the winning hook or starting angle, the audience, the visual hypothesis, the concepts and variations, the measurable result, and what you created next. Include the numbers and show the editable working-file structure.

Then show us how AI materially improved the research, concepting, or production workflow without replacing your design judgment.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • US Holidays

raw.description:
The Director of Managed Care Pharmacy Analytics leads two core components of our pharmacy product. First, in an externally facing, subject-matter-expert capacity, this role serves as the pharmacist voice on client calls, discussing payment integrity findings, creating and telling the story with analytics, and potentially acting as the clinical lead representing clients through PBM RFPs. Second, the this role acts as the clinical subject-matter expert on model development, ensuring payment integrity models make clinical and operational sense. Across both, this role brings enough command of PBM operations and analytics to drive realistic, actionable recommendations, partners closely with the data science team, and speaks to findings independently with clients and PBMs. This Position also collaborates with cross-functional teams, including product, account management, legal advisors, operations, and technology, to develop and implement pharmacy strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

Client PBM Guidance:

  • Serve as the primary pharmacy/clinical subject-matter expert on client calls, discussing payment integrity findings and translating analytics into clear, actionable stories for clients.

  • Bring a working knowledge of PBM operations, including how claims adjudicate and how pricing/rebate terms are administered in practice.

  • Potentially act as the clinical lead for PBM RFP evaluations and collaborating with the analytics team to ensure contract and financial guarantee findings are clinically and contractually sound.

Clinical Model Development & Payment Integrity:

  • Partner with the data science team to shape and validate the clinical logic behind pharmacy models and AI/algorithm development, including formulary and utilization management rules, drug classification, specialty/LDD designations, and payment integrity trend and anomaly detection.

  • Ensure new and existing analytic capabilities make clinical and operational sense before they enrich our pharmacy products or reach other departments.

  • Ensure payment integrity findings are integrated into the broader PBM strategy and client-narrative, rather than treated as a standalone deliverable.

Strategy & Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Contribute to the strategic direction of the pharmacy offering, with a focus on improving client PBM knowledge, payment integrity, and analytics outcomes.

  • Work closely with leadership to shape the vision and goals for pharmacy-related strategy, PBM operations, and payment integrity initiatives.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data science, account management, legal advisors, operations, and technology, to develop and implement pharmacy strategies.

Regulatory Compliance and Industry Standards:

  • Stay current on evolving healthcare regulations, pharmacy industry standards, and payer requirements.

  • Ensure PBM strategy and payment integrity work align with government regulations (e.g., CMS, CAA) and payer contract requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Education:

  • PharmD, with a Managed Care Residency preferred

  • Training in analytic methods and/or pharmacy data analysis recommended

  • Experience:

  • Minimum 6–8 years of experience in pharmacy benefit management, with meaningful client-facing or PBM-facing experience.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in analyzing pharmacy claims data, especially payment integrity issues.

  • Demonstrated understanding of how PBM operations work in practice, e.g., how claims adjudicate, how pricing/rebate terms are administered, and where contract terms and real-world operations diverge. This is often gained through roles such as trade/rebate contract negotiation, account management, clinical data science/analytics, or PBM clinical/claims operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to interpret PBM contract terms (pricing guarantees, rebate arrangements, definitions) and connect them to clinical and financial impact.

  • Comfortable partnering closely with an analytics team and speaking independently to their findings, without personally performing every underlying analysis.

  • Skills:

  • Strong executive presence; able to represent SmartLight independently in front of clients and PBMs.

  • Advanced knowledge of pharmacy benefits, PBM contracting and operations, claims adjudication, and formulary/utilization management.

  • Comfortable engaging with data science teams on model logic, clinical assumptions, and validation, without requiring a technical/data science background.

  • Excellent communication skills, translating complex clinical and contractual findings for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Strong collaboration and partnership skills, working effectively across teams without direct authority.

Key Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and clinical judgment, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and risk in pharmacy contract, claims, and operational data.

  • Ability to drive change and influence PBM discussions and outcomes based on data and clinical insight.

  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and compliance.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach to client and PBM challenges.

Who is SmartLight Analytics

SmartLight Analytics was formed by a group of industry insiders who wanted to make a meaningful impact on the rising cost of healthcare. With this end in mind, SmartLight works for self-funded employers to reduce the wasteful spend in their healthcare plan through our proprietary data analysis. Our process works behind the scenes to save money without interrupting employee benefits or requiring employee behavior changes.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys turning product ideas and designs into polished, production-ready mobile experiences. You’ll work across native and cross-platform development, UI/UX implementation, API integrations, performance optimization, testing, and production releases.

You’ll collaborate closely with designers, backend engineers, QA, and product teams to ship mobile applications that are fast, reliable, scalable, and enjoyable to use.

If you care equally about engineering quality, application performance, and user experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Mobile Application Development

  • Develop and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android
  • Build native applications using:
    • Swift / Xcode
    • Kotlin / Java
    • iOS SDK
    • Android SDK
  • Develop cross-platform applications using:
    • React Native
    • Flutter
  • Build new product features and improve existing functionality
  • Write clean, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready code
  • Follow mobile development best practices and architecture standards
  • Build with long-term scalability and maintainability in mind

UI/UX Implementation

  • Translate Figma and product designs into polished mobile interfaces
  • Build responsive experiences across:
    • Smartphones
    • Tablets
    • Different screen sizes and resolutions
  • Maintain consistency with product design systems and UI standards
  • Collaborate with designers to improve usability and interaction quality
  • Implement intuitive navigation and interaction patterns
  • Ensure interfaces remain visually polished across supported devices

API Integration & Backend Connectivity

  • Integrate mobile applications with:
    • REST APIs
    • Backend services
    • Authentication systems
    • Third-party services
  • Handle networking, data synchronization, and application state efficiently
  • Troubleshoot integration issues between mobile and backend systems
  • Optimize API communication for speed and reliability
  • Handle failures and unexpected responses appropriately
  • Collaborate with backend engineers when integration changes are required

Performance & Application Stability

  • Monitor and improve:
    • Application speed
    • Responsiveness
    • Memory usage
    • Battery efficiency
    • Overall stability
  • Identify and resolve crashes, bugs, and performance bottlenecks
  • Optimize application behavior across supported devices
  • Ensure consistent performance across operating system versions
  • Build features with scalability and long-term maintainability in mind
  • Investigate and resolve production issues quickly

Testing & Quality

  • Test features across multiple devices and operating system versions
  • Debug application issues and resolve defects before release
  • Support regression testing and production validation
  • Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to maintain high release quality
  • Validate new functionality before deployment
  • Identify device-specific and OS-specific issues
  • Help prevent critical defects from reaching production

Deployment & Release Management

  • Prepare applications for production releases
  • Manage or support:
    • Apple App Store submissions
    • Google Play Store releases
  • Maintain versioning and release workflows
  • Prepare production builds
  • Monitor applications following deployment
  • Investigate and resolve post-release issues
  • Support reliable and repeatable release processes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of mobile application development experience
  • Strong experience with iOS and/or Android development
  • Hands-on knowledge of:
    • Swift
    • Kotlin / Java
    • iOS SDK
    • Android SDK
  • Experience with cross-platform frameworks such as:
    • React Native
    • Flutter
  • Strong understanding of:
    • REST APIs
    • Mobile networking
    • Authentication
    • Application lifecycle
  • Familiarity with architecture patterns such as:
    • MVVM
    • MVC
    • MVP
  • Strong understanding of mobile UI/UX best practices
  • Experience translating product designs into functional mobile interfaces
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, and QA teams
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience publishing production applications to:
    • Apple App Store
    • Google Play Store
  • Experience with:
    • Firebase
    • Push notifications
    • Mobile analytics
    • Authentication systems
  • Experience building:
    • Offline-first functionality
    • Real-time features
    • Mobile animations
  • Startup or product-company experience
  • Experience improving performance for applications with growing user bases

Tools & Technology

Swift | Xcode | Kotlin | Java | iOS SDK | Android SDK | React Native | Flutter | REST APIs | Firebase | Git | Figma | Apple App Store | Google Play Store

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy building mobile products people actually use
  • Care about both engineering quality and user experience
  • Can translate Figma designs into polished, functional interfaces
  • Think about performance, scalability, and maintainability while building
  • Can troubleshoot technical issues independently
  • Understand the differences between native and cross-platform development
  • Pay attention to application stability and device-specific behavior
  • Communicate effectively with product, design, QA, and backend teams
  • Take ownership from initial development through production release
  • Care about the small details that make mobile applications feel polished

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing current development priorities, checking the latest build, or debugging an issue reported in production.

Throughout the day, you could build new mobile features, translate designs into responsive interfaces, integrate APIs and backend services, troubleshoot application issues, or optimize performance.

You’ll test functionality across devices, review code, collaborate with designers and other engineers, and prepare new builds for production release.

When an application reaches production, you’ll help monitor stability and respond quickly to issues that could affect users.

In short: you build and maintain mobile applications that are fast, stable, visually polished, and easy to use.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Application stability and crash-free performance
  • Fast and reliable feature delivery
  • Smooth performance across supported devices
  • Successful Apple App Store and Google Play releases
  • Low production defect rates
  • Fast resolution of application issues
  • Clean and maintainable code
  • Accurate implementation of approved product designs
  • Reliable API and backend integrations
  • Strong collaboration with product, design, QA, and engineering teams

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Build real mobile products from development through release
  • Exposure to both native and cross-platform development
  • Hands-on work across iOS and Android
  • High ownership over application quality and performance
  • Opportunity to work with Swift, Kotlin, React Native, and Flutter
  • Close collaboration with global product, design, and engineering teams
  • Fully remote with flexible working hours
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Mobile Engineer
    • Lead Mobile Developer
    • Mobile Architect
    • Engineering Lead

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Practical Assessment / Mobile Coding Exercise
  5. Final Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Mobile App Developer with experience in iOS, Android, Swift, Kotlin, React Native, or Flutter and enjoy building polished, production-ready applications, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build mobile products that are fast, reliable, scalable, visually polished, and genuinely enjoyable to use.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: Applied AI / AI research data

Compensation: $180K-$220K base, ~$400K+ OTE (uncapped profit share)

About the Company

Our partner is a fast-growing applied AI research lab that builds high-quality reinforcement-learning environments and agents sold to the world's leading AI labs. In under two years they have scaled to a nine-figure revenue run rate and grown their team severalfold in a matter of months, backed by leading venture investors. Quality is their core differentiator, and they are rapidly expanding into new domains.

The Opportunity

As an RL Environment Software Engineer, you will sit at the intersection of research engineering and traditional software engineering, building the environments that simulate real-world workflows and the agents that automate them. This is forward-looking work, you will help research and predict what high-quality environments the frontier will need next, then build them from the ground up.

You will join a brand-new RL team being assembled with exceptional talent, with a clear path to grow alongside it as the function scales into industry pods.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-quality RL environments that simulate real working environments end to end.
  • Develop agents for the tasks within those environments and iterate until they are efficient and production-ready.
  • Partner with the research team to scope which environments to build and why, staying ahead of future demand rather than only meeting present needs.
  • Own the backend and infrastructure layers that make environments reliable and scalable.
  • Help set engineering standards for a zero-to-one team as the RL function grows.

Requirements

  • Strong machine-learning engineers who code heavily and build systems from scratch, with strong intuition for reinforcement learning.
  • Proficiency across a modern stack, Node.js and Python on the backend and React/TypeScript on the frontend, with strong Kubernetes and Docker skills.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership and long hours.
  • A track record of meaningful tenure and impact at previous companies.
  • Reinforcement-learning experience or an RL research background is a strong plus, though not required.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Through the MatchaTalent Hiring Partner Program, external recruiters and sourcing professionals can collaborate with MatchaTalent on active recruitment assignments.

About the Role

The Hiring Partner is responsible primarily for candidate sourcing and initial qualification based on the requirements of assigned positions.

Hiring Partners work with MatchaTalent's Recruitment Delivery team to identify suitable candidates and submit qualified profiles for further recruitment processes.

This role is suitable for recruiters with experience in agency recruitment, in-house recruitment, executive search, freelance recruitment, or talent sourcing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source candidates for junior, mid-level, senior, managerial, and executive positions
  • Review candidate profiles against job requirements
  • Conduct initial discussions with candidates to assess their background, experience, interest, availability, and expectations
  • Submit qualified candidates that meet the requirements of the assigned position
  • Provide relevant candidate information and feedback to the MatchaTalent team
  • Coordinate with Recruitment Delivery Managers regarding hiring requirements and candidate feedback

  • Follow MatchaTalent's candidate qualification and submission standards

Requirements

  • Previous experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, executive search, or related fields
  • Experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, professional networks, or other sourcing channels
  • Good understanding of candidate profiles and job requirements
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to assess candidate suitability based on specific requirements
  • Detail-oriented when reviewing CVs and candidate information
  • Able to work independently and manage sourcing activities effectively

This position is part of the MatchaTalent Hiring Partner Program.

Hiring Partners work together with MatchaTalent's internal recruitment team. The Hiring Partner's primary focus is candidate sourcing and qualification, while the MatchaTalent team manages the subsequent recruitment and client coordination processes.

We are seeking a skilled SAP Data Migration expert with extensive experience in SAP data migration projects with previous experience on Syniti tools (ADM or ADMM). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP data models and migration processes, coupled with the ability to interact with cross-functional teams, ensure data quality, and deliver on project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in end-to-end data migration projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and SAP implementation strategies.

  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards throughout the migration process.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in SAP data migration roles for greenfield or brownfield projects. Expertise on data migration methodology (mock cycles, validation approach, etc.) is a must.
  • Proven experience with data migration tools including LTMC, DMC, BODS, Syniti tools (e.g., Syniti ADMM/SKP, Syniti Knowledge Platform) and its various modules including Reporting hub, Migrate & Construct.
  • Experience with legacy SAP data tools like LSMW, MASS, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP certification in one or more technical areas is a plus.

Care Navigation and Benefits Specialist - Remote

If you know the VA system well enough that colleagues have turned to you when a Veteran's situation became complicated, this opportunity may be worth a conversation.

We're looking for an experienced care navigation professional who can bring that knowledge to a growing Veteran-focused care coordination program. You'll help Veterans navigate healthcare, benefits, behavioral health services, community resources, and other support while also helping the broader care team handle complex cases more effectively.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to do more than manage individual cases. You'll serve as a resource to other care coordinators, help improve Veteran-specific workflows, identify gaps in the program, contribute to training, and help shape how care coordination is delivered as the program develops.

The Experience That Matters Most

We're particularly interested in someone whose background brings together Veteran or VA experience, care coordination, and increasing program responsibility.

You'll need:

  • 5+ years of experience as a clinical social worker, care coordinator, care navigator, or in a similar field, with demonstrated progressive program management experience
  • Direct experience working with Veterans and/or within the VA system
  • 1+ years of experience working successfully in a remote environment
  • Knowledge of VA healthcare, Veteran benefits and resources, behavioral health, and social determinants of health
  • Experience supporting medically and/or behaviorally complex populations
  • Experience documenting cases within a care management or electronic health record system
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Experience with motivational interviewing is also important.

A social work license is not required, although candidates with credentials such as an LMSW or similar professional background are encouraged to apply. Fluent Spanish is helpful but is not required.

How You'll Make an Impact

You'll help Veterans understand and navigate available resources, including VA healthcare, benefits, community care, and other services that address healthcare and social needs.

You'll also guide complex Veteran cases, help determine appropriate referrals and escalations, and step in with direct Veteran support when specialized assistance is needed.

Beyond individual cases, you'll help develop Veteran-specific care coordination workflows, identify opportunities to improve the program, and work with care coordination and training leadership to strengthen the team's understanding of VA healthcare, benefits navigation, Veteran resources, and common barriers to care.

In short, your experience will help both the Veteran in front of you and the team supporting the Veterans who come next.

Location, Schedule and Compensation

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week remote position working Monday through Friday during normal Central Time business hours.

Candidates must reside in the Central Time Zone in Texas, Alabama, Mississippi, Louisiana, or Tennessee and have a dedicated home-office environment.

The anticipated salary range is $80,000 to $100,000, with potential flexibility based on the selected candidate's experience and background.

Travel is not required.

If you've spent several years helping Veterans navigate complex healthcare or benefit systems and you're ready for a position where that experience can influence a broader program, we'd like to talk with you.
