raw.excerpt: The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities.
raw.description:
The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations.

For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings.

This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting.

The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared.

What You’ll Do

Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support

  • Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories.

  • Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach.

  • Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage.

  • Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests.

  • Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters.

  • Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings.

  • Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.

Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support

  • Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity.

  • Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points.

  • Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.

  • Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant.

  • Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging.

  • Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager.

Sales Alignment & Enablement

  • Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points.

  • Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate.

  • Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team.

  • Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.

  • Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.

  • Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.

  • Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.

  • The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

What You Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role.

  • Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges.

  • Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment.

  • Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs.

  • Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests.

  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed.

  • Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus.

  • Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

Digital Remedy is a performance media partner for agencies, brands, and media companies. Through proprietary technology, services, and partnerships, Digital Remedy offers outcome-based media solutions for marketers empowering them to exceed beyond standard media goals. Whether brand or outcome focused, marketers can access insights, media planning, activation, measurement, reporting, and optimization capabilities to deliver the highest performance tied to ROI. About the Role

As Manger of Technical Recruiting, you will own ActAI's global technical recruiting function and be accountable for building the engineering and AI teams required to scale the company.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own technical hiring across ActAI, including AI/ML, backend, infrastructure, web, mobile and engineering leadership.

  • Build the technical recruiting strategy, team structure, hiring priorities and operating cadence required to meet company hiring goals.

  • Personally lead searches for critical and senior hires, from market mapping and headhunting through assessment, offer negotiation and closing.

  • Build and coach a high-performing technical recruiting team, reviewing pipelines and raising the quality of sourcing, assessment and candidate management.

  • Use recruiting data and market intelligence to identify bottlenecks, challenge ineffective searches and continuously improve hiring quality, speed and conversion.

  • Build scalable recruiting processes and talent networks across the US, Europe and Asia without allowing process to replace judgement or execution.

What You Will Need

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience with deep experience hiring software engineering, AI/ML or other highly technical talent.

  • Proven track record building and leading technical recruiting for a high-growth technology company while remaining hands-on with critical searches.

  • Strong understanding of engineering and AI talent markets, with the ability to assess the substance and relevance of highly technical profiles.

  • Demonstrated success hiring senior engineers, technical leaders and other scarce talent through proactive headhunting.

  • Experience building, managing and raising the performance of technical recruiting teams.

  • Ability to work directly with founders and engineering leaders, challenge assumptions and translate company priorities into executable hiring plans.

  • Strong judgement on talent, high execution speed and clear accountability for hiring outcomes.

  • Experience leading technical recruiting at an AI company, AI-native startup or high-growth technology company.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

About the Role

As Head of Technical Recruiting, you will own ActAI's global technical recruiting function and be accountable for building the engineering and AI teams required to scale the company.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own technical hiring across ActAI, including AI/ML, backend, infrastructure, web, mobile and engineering leadership.

  • Build the technical recruiting strategy, team structure, hiring priorities and operating cadence required to meet company hiring goals.

  • Personally lead searches for critical and senior hires, from market mapping and headhunting through assessment, offer negotiation and closing.

  • Set the standard for candidate quality, ensuring recruiters evaluate actual technical contribution, complexity and relevance rather than relying on titles, companies or keywords.

  • Partner directly with engineering and company leadership to define hiring bars, target profiles, interview processes and final hiring decisions.

  • Build and coach a high-performing technical recruiting team, reviewing pipelines and raising the quality of sourcing, assessment and candidate management.

  • Use recruiting data and market intelligence to identify bottlenecks, challenge ineffective searches and continuously improve hiring quality, speed and conversion.

  • Build scalable recruiting processes and talent networks across the US, Europe and Asia without allowing process to replace judgement or execution.

What You Will Need

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience with deep experience hiring software engineering, AI/ML or other highly technical talent.

  • Proven track record building and leading technical recruiting for a high-growth technology company while remaining hands-on with critical searches.

  • Strong understanding of engineering and AI talent markets, with the ability to assess the substance and relevance of highly technical profiles.

  • Demonstrated success hiring senior engineers, technical leaders and other scarce talent through proactive headhunting.

  • Experience building, managing and raising the performance of technical recruiting teams.

  • Ability to work directly with founders and engineering leaders, challenge assumptions and translate company priorities into executable hiring plans.

  • Strong judgement on talent, high execution speed and clear accountability for hiring outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading technical recruiting at an AI company, AI-native startup or high-growth technology company.

  • Direct experience recruiting AI researchers, ML engineers, applied AI engineers and senior engineering leaders.

  • Strong existing networks across global AI and engineering communities.

Job title: Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing

Location: 100% remote; candidates must be based in the United States or Canada and available during North American business hours

Employment: Full-time

Salary: US$70,000–$85,000 base salary, plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000, depending on ability and experience.

Everis is hiring an early-career analyst to build the pipeline of businesses we may acquire. You will research markets and companies, build relationships with brokers, contact owners, qualify opportunities, do initial analysis, and hand the strongest deals to our acquisition team with clear notes.

This is a sourcing and relationship role, not a traditional investment-banking role. Your main responsibility is high-quality deal flow. You will see evaluation, diligence, and transactions, but the deal team owns complex modelling, diligence, negotiation, and execution.

Why join Everis

  • Work directly on acquisition strategy and see how a lead becomes a serious opportunity.

  • Speak with brokers, advisers, founders, and owners while learning what makes a business attractive and why owners sell.

  • Research varied industries, use modern AI and sourcing tools, take ownership quickly, and grow into broader acquisition responsibilities.

About Everis

Everis is a software holding company with $27 million in annual recurring revenue. We buy B2B SaaS companies from the founders who built them and keep them permanently. We invest our own capital and operate without the pressure of a fund exit timeline. Our remote team strengthens engineering and product, pricing, go-to-market, retention, revenue operations, and back-office systems across the portfolio.

What you’ll work on

Broker and intermediary relationships

  • Find and build relationships with relevant brokers, advisers, marketplaces, and other deal sources.

  • Stay in regular contact, understand what they have coming to market, and follow up consistently.

  • Screen brokered and marketplace opportunities against Everis’s criteria and surface the strongest ones quickly.

Owner sourcing and outreach

  • Build targeted lists of businesses and owners that may fit our criteria.

  • Find and verify decision-maker contacts, then run thoughtful outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.

  • Hold initial conversations, understand each owner’s goals, and follow up professionally over what may be a long cycle.

Research and qualification

  • Understand what each business does, how it makes money, who its customers are, and what makes it defensible.

  • Gather high-level information on revenue, profit, growth, recurring revenue, customer concentration, owner involvement, asking price, sale motivation, and timing.

  • Assess fit, prepare short opportunity briefs and notes, and coordinate a clean handoff to the deal team.

Pipeline ownership and improvement

  • Keep the acquisition CRM accurate, including contacts, source, stage, notes, next action, financial snippets, risks, and follow-up dates.

  • Track outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, handoffs, and funnel progression. Provide concise weekly reporting.

  • Use evidence and AI tools to improve research, outreach, recordkeeping, and the sourcing methods that produce the best opportunities.

What we’re looking for

  • Evidence of exceptional ability through one specific, verifiable accomplishment with unusual difficulty, selectivity, or impact—and a clear explanation of what you personally contributed.

  • Alternatively, direct acquisition experience that includes all three: analysing small or mid-sized SaaS or mobile-app businesses, judging their attractiveness as acquisition targets, and engaging owners or founders about acquisition fit or motivations.

  • Strong research and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and communicate credibly with brokers, advisers, owners, and founders. You are smart, curious, and able to learn quickly.

  • Excellent spoken and written communication. You are comfortable making cold calls, sending outbound messages, hearing no, and following up consistently without relying on finance jargon.

  • Highly organized, reliable, proactive, and resilient. You maintain accurate notes, follow through on commitments, handle confidential information with integrity, and work effectively without constant supervision.

  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, research databases, and AI tools, with basic financial and commercial literacy or the ability to learn quickly.

This role is designed for candidates with zero to three years of professional experience. Prior acquisition or sales experience is not required when a candidate demonstrates exceptional ability. Generic sales results, outreach volume, list building, financial modelling, credentials, or employer prestige do not establish a strong match on their own.

What we offer

  • US$70,000–$85,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000.

  • 100% remote work from the United States or Canada.

  • Direct exposure to founders, brokers, owners, and real acquisition opportunities.

  • Meaningful responsibility early, with a path into senior deal origination, acquisitions, or broader operating work.

If you want to learn how great businesses are found and directly help build Everis’s acquisition pipeline, we’d like to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $70K - $85K

raw.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Mamaya Health is seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable Assistant to join our Revenue Cycle Management team. This role supports the financial health of the organization through accurate claims management, insurance follow-up, denial resolution, payment research, and maintenance of outstanding accounts receivable.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with mental and/or behavioral health billing and understands the full insurance claim lifecycle. This individual should be comfortable independently researching complex claim issues, communicating with insurance carriers, identifying the root cause of denials or underpayments, and taking appropriate action to bring claims to resolution.

The Accounts Receivable Specialist will work closely with the revenue cycle manager and other members of the Mamaya Health team to ensure claims are processed accurately and efficiently while providing professional, compassionate support to clients and staff.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Previous experience in mental and/or behavioral health medical billing.
  • Working knowledge of Commercial, EAP, and Medicaid insurance plans.
  • Strong understanding of primary and secondary insurance billing, including coordination of benefits (COB), claim sequencing, and secondary claim submission.
  • Experience researching and resolving insurance denials, rejections, underpayments, overpayments, and requests for additional information.
  • Knowledge of eligibility, benefits, copays, deductibles, coinsurance, and patient responsibility.
  • Comfort communicating directly with insurance carriers regarding claim status and resolution.
  • Dependable, organized, detail-oriented, adaptable, and able to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, initiative, critical thinking, and problem-solving ability.
  • Ability to work independently while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Behavioral or mental health billing experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Commercial, EAP, and Medicaid billing requirements.
  • Experience working insurance Accounts Receivable (AR).
  • Experience with claim submission, corrected claims, reconsiderations, appeals, and denial management.
  • Familiarity with payer portals and electronic claim systems.

• Experience with AdvancedMD preferred.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to research complex billing issues through resolution.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work assigned insurance AR queues and maintain accounts within aging expectations established by Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Investigate claim denials, rejections, edits, underpayments, overpayments, requests for information, and other payer correspondence.
  • Identify root causes of claim issues and take appropriate corrective action.
  • Review claims for billing accuracy and correct errors prior to resubmission.
  • Submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals when appropriate.
  • Follow up directly with insurance carriers and payer representatives regarding outstanding or incorrectly processed claims.
  • Appropriately process claims involving primary and secondary insurance, including coordination of benefits and claim submission order.
  • Submit or facilitate secondary claims after primary insurance adjudication.
  • Obtain necessary documentation or information from clients, providers, or internal team members to resolve outstanding claims.
  • Assist with obtaining or correcting insurance information when necessary.
  • Document all claim follow-up activity and payer communications clearly and accurately.
  • Generate and maintain reports necessary to ensure assigned AR is actively worked.
  • Identify recurring denial trends or payer issues and communicate findings to Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk accounts appropriately and support other Revenue Cycle functions as needed.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

HOURS & LOCATION

  • Part-time position with the potential to transition to full-time based on organizational needs.
  • Monday through Friday; hours to be discussed during interview process
  • This is a remote, work-from-home position.

SUPPORT & EMPOWERMENT

The Accounts Receivable Specialist will work closely with and receive support from Mamaya Health's Revenue Cycle leadership team. We believe strong revenue cycle performance requires collaboration, accountability, clear communication, and giving team members the resources and autonomy necessary to resolve issues effectively.

ABOUT MAMAYA HEALTH

Mamaya Health is committed to creating an environment centered on compassionate, accessible mental healthcare. Our team values collaboration, inclusivity, authenticity, continuous improvement, and providing an exceptional experience for both our clients and our staff.

We are looking for someone who understands the technical side of Revenue Cycle Management and recognizes that every claim represents a client receiving care.

Salary: $24

Scrum Master

We are seeking a Scrum Master to support a public sector digital transformation and service delivery initiative. This role will work with cross-functional program review and product delivery teams to drive modern digital practices, service innovation, and organizational modernization. The Scrum Master will identify and remove roadblocks, facilitate agile ceremonies, mentor teams in agile principles, and enable consistent delivery of product features and services that better serve the public.

This position requires someone who can lead and mentor cross-functional teams in agile methodology and facilitate key agile ceremonies to support digital transformation projects across multiple public sector organizations. The Scrum Master will coach teams on effective estimation, sprint commitments, and the elimination of blocking issues, while acting as an intermediary between product owners and delivery teams. The role demands demonstrated AI fluency through daily use of generative AI and agentic tooling for delivery-grade work, including drafting, analysis, structured retrieval, backlog support, meeting synthesis, delivery reporting, and automation. The Scrum Master must demonstrate process automation literacy, including workflow automation, digital forms, structured intake, status reporting, and agentic process orchestration, and translate technical change into accessible communication for business stakeholders, product owners, delivery teams, and staff. Additional responsibilities include maintaining delivery metrics, reporting on progress using project management tools and artifacts such as sprint burndown and velocity charts, and participating in digital service delivery activities such as user research and usability testing.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years - coaching teams on agile methodologies, facilitating agile ceremonies, and fostering continuous improvement and collaboration
  • 3+ years - leading and facilitating key agile ceremonies including planning sessions, stand-ups, product demonstrations, and retrospectives
  • 3+ years - working within an agile development environment
  • Demonstrated AI fluency through daily use of generative AI and agentic tooling for delivery-grade work including drafting, analysis, structured retrieval, backlog support, meeting synthesis, delivery reporting, and automation
  • Proficiency in prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation of AI output for risk, hallucination, privacy, sensitivity, and appropriateness for delivery environments
  • Ability to build AI-augmented routines that improve team delivery practices and reduce administrative overhead
  • Demonstrated process automation literacy including workflow automation, digital forms, structured intake, status reporting, and agentic process orchestration
  • Ability to translate technical change and automation impacts into accessible communication for staff, product owners, delivery teams, and stakeholders
  • Ability to maintain delivery metrics and report on product level plans, progress, and quality assurance using project management tools and artifacts such as sprint burndown and velocity charts

Required Certifications

  • Active Certified Scrum Master certification

Nice to Have

  • 5+ years - delivering training sessions via web-based interactive technology such as Teams
  • 1+ years - guiding agile teams in accountability and self-organization with focus on coaching teams to integrate AI into their ways of working without replacing human judgment, collaboration, creativity, or decision-making
  • 4+ years - implementing CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, deployment, and observability
  • 1+ years - personally using AI tools to enhance and streamline Scrum Master responsibilities including meeting preparation, documentation, reporting, backlog analysis, communication, and agile delivery support
  • 5+ years - planning work that aligns to product owner priorities including sprint planning and backlog planning
  • 6+ years - software development processes and all associated best practices, methods, standards, tools, and policies
  • 4+ years - working within North American public sector environments including municipal, provincial, and federal organizations
  • 2+ years - working with teams that apply UX design, service design, design thinking, or human-centered design approaches

raw.description:
The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.

The Clinical Research Associate role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.

The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.

Clinical Trial Monitoring

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality;

  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met;

  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery;

  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites;

  • Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks;

  • Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F);

  • Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level;

  • Conduct remote assessment of e diary data;

  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies;

  • Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution;

  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics;

  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues;

  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines;

  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities;

  • Support database release as needed;

  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where appropriate. Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

  • Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team

  • Interact with investigator site health care professionals in a manner which enhances Pfizer’s credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate Pfizer’s clinical development goals

  • Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators

  • Drive Quality Event submission and remediation, when applicable

  • Serve as a point of contact for audit conduct, and drive Audit Observation CAPA development and checks, when applicable.

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

Student Intern - HHSIAN

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) organization helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risk. Our goal is to proactively provide an independent assessment of the firm’s risk while supporting the business segments’ pursuit of profitable growth. ERM is responsible for traditional risks such as Financial & Market Risk, Insurance Risk, and Operational Risk, as well as understanding new and emerging risks such as Cyber Security and AI.

What’s in it for you?

Joining The Hartford’s ERM Summer Internship Program is a great way to launch your career, enhance your business acumen and gain insight into the risk management field. Summer interns are placed into meaningful roles that have an immediate impact on the business. Over the course of ten weeks, you will:

  • Develop your knowledge of risk management and required corporate skills during a weekly training series
  • Attend multiple collaborative events with ERM teammates and leadership
  • Apply your education and unique skills to a summer-long project culminating in a Capstone presentation to senior management
  • Gain career accelerating skills through on-the-job learning, exposure to ERM and Hartford leadership, and 1-on-1 mentoring
  • Successful interns may be offered full-time employment into The Hartford’s ERM organization upon graduation.

What is The Hartford looking for?

  • Students expecting to graduate in January 2027 or May of 2028 with a Bachelor’s degree and a GPA of 3.2 or higher
  • Desired majors include, but are not limited to Business, Finance, IT, Math, Economics, Geoscience, Statistics, Risk Management & Insurance, or Engineering
  • Interest in risk management
  • Analytical and critical thinking/problem solving skills
  • Strong communication and leadership skills
  • Desire to work in a collaborative/team-based environment

Compensation

The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

$25 - $26

Job Description:

Title: Sr. Director, RO Commercialization

Location: Remote - Frequent Travel required

Position Summary
Reporting to the VP, Cardiac Imaging, you will lead the commercial organization responsible for commercializing and scaling RPO(reprocessing) products and services across the company’s operating companies and franchises. Own commercial strategy and go-to-market execution for current and new RPO offerings, including sustainability programs, customer targeting and pipeline management, product launches, pricing, and partner development. Drive adoption of an RPO model shift to support growth, improve margins, and position the company as the provider of choice for reprocessing solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
•Define and lead the RPO commercialization strategy across operating
companies/franchises to achieve annual revenue, margin and sustainability

targets.

  • Build and manage a high-performing commercial organization (product
    marketing, launch management, commercial operations, customer service) to
    execute sales and marketing plans.
    •Own customer targeting, pipeline development and conversion strategies;
    partner closely with Field Sales to drive territory plans and attainment.
    •Develop and implement marketing programs, sales tools and product positioning
    to support regional and national sales needs.
    •Lead all new product introductions for RPO-related products and services:
    market analysis, business case development ($sales, profitability, ROI/NPV),
    pricing strategy, launch planning and performance measurement.
    •Create robust product lifecycle plans including portfolio rationalization,
    competitive analysis, pricing, and end-of-life strategies.
  • Develop, maintain, and operationalize the overall RPO portfolio pricing strategy
    and pricing matrix.
    •Establish and track commercial KPIs and dashboards (revenue, margin, pipeline
    health, product adoption, contract renewals, customer satisfaction, sustainability
    metrics).
    •Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply
    Chain, Finance and Legal to ensure compliant and executable product plans.
    •Drive strategic partnerships and third-party vendor relationships to expand
    capabilities and reach.
    •Oversee national/regional contract negotiations and key account management
    where applicable.
    •Hire, develop and retain talent; model and reinforce company values and
    safety/compliance expectations.
    •Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations and company policies
    (health, safety, quality).
    •Communicate business performance, risks and opportunities to senior
    leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration:
•Lead cross-franchise alignment (multiple operating companies) to develop joint
forecasting, go-to-market plans, and integrated commercialization activities.
•Establish and chair a strategic advisory group (internal/external stakeholders) to
guide long-term RPO initiatives and alignment.
•Serve as the commercial sponsor for RPO content across internal training and
customer-facing events.

Success Metrics (examples)
•Year-over-year revenue and margin growth for RPO products/services.
•On-time, on-budget execution and adoption rates for new product launches.
•Pipeline-to-order conversion rate and average deal size growth.
•Contract renewal/retention rate and net promoter/customer satisfaction scores.
  • Measurable sustainability outcomes tied to RPO programs.
    •Employee engagement and retention in the commercial organization.

Experience & Education:
•Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
•15+ years in product marketing, product commercialization, or sales leadership;
experience managing large, cross-functional teams.
•Prior experience in medical device, healthcare services, or related regulated
industries strongly preferred.
•Demonstrated track record of launching products, leading key account contract
negotiations, and building commercial programs that delivered measurable
growth.

Required Skills & Competencies:
•Strategic thinker with the ability to simplify complexity and operationalize
strategy.
•Strong commercial and financial acumen; experience building business cases
(ROI/NPV) and setting pricing strategies.
•Excellent cross-functional influence and stakeholder management skills at senior
levels across various business lines ( R&D, Commercial, Supply Chain, etc.)
•Proven ability to develop key opinion leader and clinical relationships to support
product development and adoption.
•Data-driven decision-making and comfort with forecasting and performance
dashboards.
•Strong communication and presentation skills, with ability to engage internal and
external audiences.
•Experience with contract negotiations and vendor/partner management.

Scope & Travel:
•Expected travel up to 50% (customer-facing and regular onsite visits to core RPO
operations center).
  • Role spans multiple franchises/operating companies and has broad cross-
    functional interaction.

raw.description:
Job Summary

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to break into the medical device industry with a company that is truly making a difference in patients' lives. As a Lead Generation Representative at Insulet, you'll be the first point of contact for people who have already expressed interest in the Omnipod® system, helping guide them through the next steps in their diabetes care journey while partnering closely with the sales team. Unlike traditional cold-calling roles, you'll engage with warm leads generated through marketing campaigns and physician referrals, giving you the chance to build meaningful relationships and directly impact patient outcomes. You'll gain valuable experience in healthcare, sales, customer engagement, and CRM systems while working for a globally recognized leader in diabetes technology. With the flexibility of a 100% remote work environment, strong career growth potential, and the opportunity to contribute to a life-changing product that improves the quality of life for people living with diabetes, this role offers both professional development and a strong sense of purpose.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level by joining a global medical device market leader in diabetes care? At Insulet Corporation, we are transforming lives with innovative products that empower people living with diabetes to take control of their health. Over years of technological advances, we developed Omnipod®, a line of tubeless, wearable, Pod-based insulin management systems.

The hours for this role will be 9:00am to 6:00pm Local Time. Will consider candidates living in any time zone.

Position Overview

In this entry level role, we are looking for an energetic and detail-oriented Bilingual Lead Generation Representative to join our Inside Sales team. This role will be responsible for the tactical execution of the new customer acquisition strategy as well as collaborating with our sales team to ensure the successful transfer of a qualified lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for making outbound calls to patients who have expressed interest in the OmniPod System.

  • Responsible for handling inbound calls from patients generated through physicians’ offices as well as through marketing programs.

  • Introduce our sales team process to prospective patients

  • Apply knowledge of Insulet’s products to answer customer’s inquiries about the OmniPod product and competitive comparisons to move prospects through the sales cycle in agreed upon time frames.

  • Generate sales qualified leads out of potential patients by converting marketing generated leads.

  • Performs other duties as required.

Education and Experience:

Minimum Requirements

  • Associates Degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree

  • Spanish Fluency

  • Experience in medical software (EMR/PM)

  • Experience in a medical practice

  • Salesforce/CRM competency

Skills and Competencies

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

  • Must have excellent communication and strong relationship building skills

Physical Requirements:

  • Requires sitting and standing associated with a normal office environment.

  • Manual dexterity needed for using a computer keyboard.

  • Lightweight lifting may be required.

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

If you’re ready to be a part of a company that’s changing the future of diabetes care, we want to hear from you. Join us at Insulet Corporation, where your talent will make a real difference in people’s lives.

NOTE: This position is eligible for 100% remote working arrangements (may work from home/virtually 100%; may also work hybrid on-site/virtual as desired).

Additional Information:

Compensation & Benefits:For U.S.-based positions only, the annual base salary range for this role is $24.26 - $36.39This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation.We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:• Medical, dental, and vision insurance• 401(k) with company match• Paid time off (PTO)• And additional employee wellness programsApplication Details:This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.To apply, please visit the Insulet Careers site and submit your application online.Actual pay depends on skills, experience, and education.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Insulet also leverages the unique design of its Pod by tailoring its Omnipod technology platform for the delivery of non-insulin subcutaneous drugs across other therapeutic areas. For more information, please visit insulet.com and omnipod.com.

We are looking for highly motivated, performance-driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it!

raw.description:
Companial is looking for a senior Country Manager to build and grow our business in Switzerland.

Today, we work with approximately 15 Swiss Microsoft Dynamics partners.. With approximately 80 Dynamics partners active in Switzerland, there is significant room to grow. Our ambition is clear: grow by building strong relantionships.

As Country Manager Switzerland, your main focus will be recruiting new Dynamics partners, developing strategic relationships and expanding Companial’s presence in the Swiss market.

You will report to the Regional Lead DACH and work closely with our teams across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the commercial growth and revenue performance of Companial in Switzerland.

  • Recruit new Microsoft Dynamics partners and develop them into long term Companial customers.

  • Build and manage relationships with key decision makers across the Swiss Dynamics ecosystem.

  • Grow existing partner relationships by introducing additional Companial services.

  • Develop and execute the commercial strategy for Switzerland.

  • Build a strong new business pipeline and take ownership from first contact through onboarding and growth.

  • Work closely with Microsoft and represent Companial at partner meetings and relevant industry events.

  • Use your own local commercial and marketing budget to support growth.

    • The role

    This is a hands on commercial role for someone who enjoys building a market.

    Our existing Swiss partners are currently managed through the German organisation. A Partner Success Manager will focus on developing these existing relationships, while your primary focus will be new partner acquisition and commercial growth.

    The Swiss team may grow to approximately two or three people over time. We are therefore looking for someone motivated by building a successful business rather than managing a large team.

    Success is measured primarily by one thing: growing revenue in Switzerland through the recruitment and development of new Dynamics partners.

What you bring

  • Senior commercial experience within the Microsoft Dynamics ecosystem within a commercial role.

  • Strong Dynamics 365 knowledge and understanding of the Microsoft partner landscape.

  • Proven experience in new business development, partner recruitment or building a market.

  • A strong new business drive combined with the ability to develop long term relationships.

  • Experience engaging senior decision makers and commercially owning a market or region.

  • Ability to built and coach a small team up to 3-5 Partner Success Managers

  • Knowledge of the Swiss Dynamics market and an existing local network are strong advantages.

  • Fluent German and English.

    • This is a remote role, however to build relationships we see you being based in Switzerland, Germany or Austria, provided you can be regularly present in the Swiss market.

What we offer

  • Ownership of building and growing Companial’s Swiss business.

  • Work remote and build your own team.

  • Significant freedom to shape the local commercial strategy.

  • Your own budget for local commercial and marketing initiatives.

  • Support from our DACH and central marketing teams.

  • Regular collaboration with the wider DACH team.

  • Face to face partner meetings in Switzerland approximately two to four times per month.

  • International Companial meetings several times per year.

    • Companial combines Dutch roots with a highly international organisation and a strong position within the Microsoft Dynamics ecosystem.

    In Switzerland, the foundation is already there. Now we are looking for someone who can build on it, open new doors and turn Switzerland into a significantly bigger market for Companial.

Does this sound like the kind of challenge you’re looking for? Great!
Apply and let’s talk about what you could build together with Companial in Switzerland.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

SALARY

Job title: Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing

Location: 100% remote; candidates must be based in the United States or Canada and available during North American business hours

Employment: Full-time

Salary: US$70,000–$85,000 base salary, plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000, depending on ability and experience.

Everis is hiring an early-career analyst to build the pipeline of businesses we may acquire. You will research markets and companies, build relationships with brokers, contact owners, qualify opportunities, do initial analysis, and hand the strongest deals to our acquisition team with clear notes.

This is a sourcing and relationship role, not a traditional investment-banking role. Your main responsibility is high-quality deal flow. You will see evaluation, diligence, and transactions, but the deal team owns complex modelling, diligence, negotiation, and execution.

Why join Everis

  • Work directly on acquisition strategy and see how a lead becomes a serious opportunity.

  • Speak with brokers, advisers, founders, and owners while learning what makes a business attractive and why owners sell.

  • Research varied industries, use modern AI and sourcing tools, take ownership quickly, and grow into broader acquisition responsibilities.

About Everis

Everis is a software holding company with $27 million in annual recurring revenue. We buy B2B SaaS companies from the founders who built them and keep them permanently. We invest our own capital and operate without the pressure of a fund exit timeline. Our remote team strengthens engineering and product, pricing, go-to-market, retention, revenue operations, and back-office systems across the portfolio.

What you’ll work on

Broker and intermediary relationships

  • Find and build relationships with relevant brokers, advisers, marketplaces, and other deal sources.

  • Stay in regular contact, understand what they have coming to market, and follow up consistently.

  • Screen brokered and marketplace opportunities against Everis’s criteria and surface the strongest ones quickly.

Owner sourcing and outreach

  • Build targeted lists of businesses and owners that may fit our criteria.

  • Find and verify decision-maker contacts, then run thoughtful outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.

  • Hold initial conversations, understand each owner’s goals, and follow up professionally over what may be a long cycle.

Research and qualification

  • Understand what each business does, how it makes money, who its customers are, and what makes it defensible.

  • Gather high-level information on revenue, profit, growth, recurring revenue, customer concentration, owner involvement, asking price, sale motivation, and timing.

  • Assess fit, prepare short opportunity briefs and notes, and coordinate a clean handoff to the deal team.

Pipeline ownership and improvement

  • Keep the acquisition CRM accurate, including contacts, source, stage, notes, next action, financial snippets, risks, and follow-up dates.

  • Track outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, handoffs, and funnel progression. Provide concise weekly reporting.

  • Use evidence and AI tools to improve research, outreach, recordkeeping, and the sourcing methods that produce the best opportunities.

What we’re looking for

  • Evidence of exceptional ability through one specific, verifiable accomplishment with unusual difficulty, selectivity, or impact—and a clear explanation of what you personally contributed.

  • Alternatively, direct acquisition experience that includes all three: analysing small or mid-sized SaaS or mobile-app businesses, judging their attractiveness as acquisition targets, and engaging owners or founders about acquisition fit or motivations.

  • Strong research and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and communicate credibly with brokers, advisers, owners, and founders. You are smart, curious, and able to learn quickly.

  • Excellent spoken and written communication. You are comfortable making cold calls, sending outbound messages, hearing no, and following up consistently without relying on finance jargon.

  • Highly organized, reliable, proactive, and resilient. You maintain accurate notes, follow through on commitments, handle confidential information with integrity, and work effectively without constant supervision.

  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, research databases, and AI tools, with basic financial and commercial literacy or the ability to learn quickly.

This role is designed for candidates with zero to three years of professional experience. Prior acquisition or sales experience is not required when a candidate demonstrates exceptional ability. Generic sales results, outreach volume, list building, financial modelling, credentials, or employer prestige do not establish a strong match on their own.

What we offer

  • US$70,000–$85,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000.

  • 100% remote work from the United States or Canada.

  • Direct exposure to founders, brokers, owners, and real acquisition opportunities.

  • Meaningful responsibility early, with a path into senior deal origination, acquisitions, or broader operating work.

If you want to learn how great businesses are found and directly help build Everis’s acquisition pipeline, we’d like to hear from you.

Compensation Range: $70K - $85K

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with mental and/or behavioral health billing and understands the full insurance claim lifecycle. This individual should be comfortable independently researching complex claim issues, communicating with insurance carriers, identifying the root cause of denials or underpayments, and taking appropriate action to bring claims to resolution.

The Accounts Receivable Specialist will work closely with the revenue cycle manager and other members of the Mamaya Health team to ensure claims are processed accurately and efficiently while providing professional, compassionate support to clients and staff.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Previous experience in mental and/or behavioral health medical billing.
  • Working knowledge of Commercial, EAP, and Medicaid insurance plans.
  • Strong understanding of primary and secondary insurance billing, including coordination of benefits (COB), claim sequencing, and secondary claim submission.
  • Experience researching and resolving insurance denials, rejections, underpayments, overpayments, and requests for additional information.
  • Knowledge of eligibility, benefits, copays, deductibles, coinsurance, and patient responsibility.
  • Comfort communicating directly with insurance carriers regarding claim status and resolution.
  • Dependable, organized, detail-oriented, adaptable, and able to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, initiative, critical thinking, and problem-solving ability.
  • Ability to work independently while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Behavioral or mental health billing experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Commercial, EAP, and Medicaid billing requirements.
  • Experience working insurance Accounts Receivable (AR).
  • Experience with claim submission, corrected claims, reconsiderations, appeals, and denial management.
  • Familiarity with payer portals and electronic claim systems.

• Experience with AdvancedMD preferred.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to research complex billing issues through resolution.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work assigned insurance AR queues and maintain accounts within aging expectations established by Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Investigate claim denials, rejections, edits, underpayments, overpayments, requests for information, and other payer correspondence.
  • Identify root causes of claim issues and take appropriate corrective action.

  • Submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and appeals when appropriate.
  • Follow up directly with insurance carriers and payer representatives regarding outstanding or incorrectly processed claims.
  • Appropriately process claims involving primary and secondary insurance, including coordination of benefits and claim submission order.
  • Submit or facilitate secondary claims after primary insurance adjudication.
  • Obtain necessary documentation or information from clients, providers, or internal team members to resolve outstanding claims.
  • Assist with obtaining or correcting insurance information when necessary.
  • Document all claim follow-up activity and payer communications clearly and accurately.
  • Generate and maintain reports necessary to ensure assigned AR is actively worked.
  • Identify recurring denial trends or payer issues and communicate findings to Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk accounts appropriately and support other Revenue Cycle functions as needed.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

HOURS & LOCATION

  • Part-time position with the potential to transition to full-time based on organizational needs.
  • Monday through Friday; hours to be discussed during interview process
  • This is a remote, work-from-home position.

dein profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Pflege- oder Medizinpädagogik oder bist Berufspädagog:in im Gesundheitswesen.

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Kinderkrankenpfleger oder als Pflegefachkraft mit Vertiefung in der Kinderkrankenpflege.

unser pitch

  • Werde Teil unserer Erfolgsstory: Auf einer sozialen Mission, den Pflegefachkräftemangel in Deutschland zu lösen

Aber das Beste an Careloop | KLETT sind: die Menschen. Komm zu uns und erleb es selbst!

raw.description:
Scrum Master

We are seeking a Scrum Master to support a public sector digital transformation and service delivery initiative. This role will work with cross-functional program review and product delivery teams to drive modern digital practices, service innovation, and organizational modernization. The Scrum Master will identify and remove roadblocks, facilitate agile ceremonies, mentor teams in agile principles, and enable consistent delivery of product features and services that better serve the public.

This position requires someone who can lead and mentor cross-functional teams in agile methodology and facilitate key agile ceremonies to support digital transformation projects across multiple public sector organizations. The Scrum Master will coach teams on effective estimation, sprint commitments, and the elimination of blocking issues, while acting as an intermediary between product owners and delivery teams. The role demands demonstrated AI fluency through daily use of generative AI and agentic tooling for delivery-grade work, including drafting, analysis, structured retrieval, backlog support, meeting synthesis, delivery reporting, and automation. The Scrum Master must demonstrate process automation literacy, including workflow automation, digital forms, structured intake, status reporting, and agentic process orchestration, and translate technical change into accessible communication for business stakeholders, product owners, delivery teams, and staff. Additional responsibilities include maintaining delivery metrics, reporting on progress using project management tools and artifacts such as sprint burndown and velocity charts, and participating in digital service delivery activities such as user research and usability testing.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years - coaching teams on agile methodologies, facilitating agile ceremonies, and fostering continuous improvement and collaboration
  • 3+ years - leading and facilitating key agile ceremonies including planning sessions, stand-ups, product demonstrations, and retrospectives
  • 3+ years - working within an agile development environment
  • Demonstrated AI fluency through daily use of generative AI and agentic tooling for delivery-grade work including drafting, analysis, structured retrieval, backlog support, meeting synthesis, delivery reporting, and automation
  • Proficiency in prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation of AI output for risk, hallucination, privacy, sensitivity, and appropriateness for delivery environments
  • Ability to build AI-augmented routines that improve team delivery practices and reduce administrative overhead
  • Demonstrated process automation literacy including workflow automation, digital forms, structured intake, status reporting, and agentic process orchestration
  • Ability to translate technical change and automation impacts into accessible communication for staff, product owners, delivery teams, and stakeholders
  • Ability to maintain delivery metrics and report on product level plans, progress, and quality assurance using project management tools and artifacts such as sprint burndown and velocity charts

Required Certifications

  • Active Certified Scrum Master certification

Nice to Have

  • 5+ years - delivering training sessions via web-based interactive technology such as Teams
  • 1+ years - guiding agile teams in accountability and self-organization with focus on coaching teams to integrate AI into their ways of working without replacing human judgment, collaboration, creativity, or decision-making
  • 4+ years - implementing CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, deployment, and observability
  • 1+ years - personally using AI tools to enhance and streamline Scrum Master responsibilities including meeting preparation, documentation, reporting, backlog analysis, communication, and agile delivery support
  • 5+ years - planning work that aligns to product owner priorities including sprint planning and backlog planning
  • 6+ years - software development processes and all associated best practices, methods, standards, tools, and policies
  • 4+ years - working within North American public sector environments including municipal, provincial, and federal organizations
  • 2+ years - working with teams that apply UX design, service design, design thinking, or human-centered design approaches

raw.description:
The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.

The Clinical Research Associate role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.

The Clinical Research Associate is responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial.

Clinical Trial Monitoring

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality;

  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through to database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met;

  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery;

  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites;

  • Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks;

  • Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F);

  • Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level;

  • Conduct remote assessment of e diary data;

  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies;

  • Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution;

  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics;

  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues;

  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines;

  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities;

  • Support database release as needed;

  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where appropriate. Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

  • Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team

  • Interact with investigator site health care professionals in a manner which enhances Pfizer’s credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate Pfizer’s clinical development goals

  • Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators

  • Drive Quality Event submission and remediation, when applicable

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali
Type:Contract
Compensation:$13/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.
  • Capture page metadata: language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work: every task is reviewed end to end by a second Bengali expert, and experienced annotators take on that review.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts: multi-column newspapers, exam papers, handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Regional-language AI data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation for training datasets.
  • Transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction or post-editing.
  • Document production: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Bengali-language material.
  • Script and encoding: Unicode normalization, Bengali input methods, numeral-form and character-form accuracy.

  • Set the tone for customer‑centricity, modeling consultative engagement, and elevating institutional relationships through data‑driven, value‑based conversations.
  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, finding opportunities to strengthen sales processes, streamline workflows, and mature the Institutional Sales motion.
  • Ensure consistency and alignment across the region by reinforcing standards for account planning, sales methodology, commercial guardrails, and institutional engagement within the field.
  • Lead with transparency and communication, providing clear updates on performance, risks, opportunities, and market signals to the team and VP, Accounts.

  • Strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate organizational direction into actionable regional plans.
  • Executive communication and presence, with strong data driven storytelling skills for institutional leaders.
  • High proficiency in Salesforce and data interpretation, using insights to guide decision making and improve execution.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including pricing, negotiation, and contract strategy.
  • Talent development approach, with the ability to mentor and elevate a hard-working team.
  • Deep understanding of higher education institutional needs, decision making structures, and value drivers.

Skills You'll Need Here:

(Required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, education, or a related field.
  • 7–10+ years of progressive sales experience in B2B, higher‑education, publishing, SaaS, or enterprise-level account management roles.
  • 3–5+ years of direct sales leadership experience, managing quota‑carrying Account Executives/Strategic Account Directors with full revenue accountability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi‑stakeholder institutional sales cycles, including executive‑level customer engagement.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with pricing strategy, discount governance, negotiation frameworks, and contract execution.
  • Exceptional communication, executive presence, and the ability to inspire confidence with senior institutional leaders.
  • Strong operational rigor with experience driving consistent processes, accountability rhythms, and performance management.
  • Track record of developing high-performing, diverse teams with a focus on talent development, succession planning, and coaching excellence.

Optional KPIs & Operating Cadence

Team quota attainment, forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage and quality (creation, conversion, velocity), win rate, cycle time, discount adherence, CU adoption and conversion rate, renewal retention, and data hygiene (Salesforce & program analytics).
