raw.title: Director of Product Execution
raw.excerpt: At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent.
raw.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

Strategy is worth what gets delivered. At LegitScript, the Director of Product Execution owns that delivery. You will own the portfolio view, run the prioritization process, and build the operating discipline that turns product direction into shipped, measured outcomes. You are not the author of the strategy or the products — your product managers own that work — but this role exists to make it count for more.

You will run prioritization on consistent criteria in a forum where the reasoning is visible, so the ranking is trusted by the teams whose work is deferred, not only the teams whose work is chosen. You will protect focus as roadmaps grow, hold every bet to a shared readiness standard, and close the loop by measuring what actually happened after launch. This is a leadership role with hands in the work: you lead through your product managers while staying close enough to the details to catch a vague requirement, an unowned dependency, or a metric that will not tell us anything.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the portfolio view: what is committed, what is in flight, what is at risk, and what has been deliberately deferred.
  • Own the prioritization process end to end, including the cadence, the criteria, and the forum where bets are ranked and the outcome is published.
  • Set and hold the readiness bar for work entering the plan: a defined problem, an intended outcome, a measure, an owner, and both signatures.
  • Drive scope discipline, breaking large bets into increments that deliver value on their own and retiring work that no longer earns its place.
  • Identify and resolve cross-squad dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and capacity contention before they become delivery risk.
  • Own the operating cadence for product, including planning, prioritization, roadmap review, launch readiness, and retrospectives.
  • Run launches end to end from the product side, including readiness, enablement, communication, and post-launch measurement.
  • Lead, coach, and grow the product management team, owning hiring, performance, and career development.
  • Set the standard for product craft, including problem definition, discovery, requirements, and success metrics.
  • Review product managers' work and give feedback that raises the standard, from sharper problem statements to clearer requirements.
  • Define and track execution metrics, including delivery predictability, cycle time, scope change, and effort spent on abandoned work.
  • Report progress to engineering leadership, the strategy organization, and the executive team with clarity and a clear point of view.

What You'll Bring:

  • 8+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers or product teams.
  • A track record of delivering complex B2B software, ideally in SaaS, fintech, regtech, compliance, trust and safety, or another domain where accuracy and defensibility matter as much as speed.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-team product portfolio, including sequencing work with visible cross-team dependencies and managing capacity across competing demands.
  • Experience running a prioritization process across competing domains, with an output trusted by the teams whose work was deferred as well as the teams whose work was chosen.
  • Experience executing a strategy you did not author, converting direction from strategy owners into delivered, measured outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with an engineering counterpart as a peer, with a clean boundary between product intent and technical execution.
  • Fluency in modern delivery practice, including incremental delivery, iterative planning, and release approaches that get value to customers early.
  • Enough technical depth to engage credibly with architecture and platform trade-offs, and the judgment not to mistake that for owning them.
  • Strong analytical practice, including defining delivery and outcome metrics, instrumenting for them, and changing course when the data says to.
  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to make a complex trade-off legible to an executive, an engineer, and a customer in the same document.
  • Comfort operating through change, including establishing durable operating practices where none exist and improving them without disrupting delivery.
  • A four-year college degree or a comparable blend of education and experience. We value practical skills, a strong work ethic, and a passion for learning, regardless of formal education

Preferred:

  • Experience in products that combine software automation with expert human review.
  • Domain experience in payments, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, supplements, financial crime, marketplaces, or advertising platforms.
  • Experience with platform, API, or integration products serving enterprise partners.
  • Experience establishing product operating discipline in an organization that did not previously have it.

We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Summary
The Central Monitor (CM II) will perform remote patient data review activities for Phase I-IV clinical research and/or non-interventional studies (NIS) to assess compliance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, and/or all applicable local and federal regulatory requirements. The CM II will also ensure patient safety and data integrity using a variety of technologies. Performs all tasks routinely and independently, seeking guidance as needed.
Responsibilities
  • Reviews and understands protocol, critical data and process, safety, and data integrity risks related to protocol execution.•
    Reviews patient data listings and visualizations via analytical dashboards and/or reports to confirm eligibility, identify protocol deviations, patient safety concerns, data integrity issues and illogical/inaccurate/missing data.
• Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.•
Immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans.
  • Documents observations noted during reviews and writes queries, protocol deviations or action items as necessary in appropriate systems for action by sites, CRAs or other functional team members.
    • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
    • Accesses vendor systems or reports to verify the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol, that laboratory and other procedures have been performed, that eTMF data is current and complete.
    • Documents completion of activities via tracking, reporting and/or other required project documents as per SOPs and Monitoring Plan.
    • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages patient- and site-level activities to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met.
    • Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA/LCMDA, to changing priorities to achieve goals/targets.
    • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor meetings. Participates in project staff meetings, as applicable and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
    • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R2) Guidelines and/or other applicable regulatory requirements.
• Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies.
•Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, calculating, pivoting).
•Proficient with Analytical Data Visualization Tools (adjusting visualizations, selecting subsets of data to analyze).
•Excellent verbal and written communication skills to relate to internal stakeholders. Able to inform, influence and communicate cross-functionally.

•Strong analytical skills.

•Developing therapeutic expertise.

  • <10% travel (limited to trainings, investigator meetings)

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

The RFP Manager leads Elovate's proposal development function, owning the end-to-end process for responding to requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for quotes (RFQs), and requests for information (RFIs) from municipal and government agency clients. This role combines strong writing and editing skills with disciplined project management, ensuring every proposal is accurate, compelling, on-brand, and delivered on time. The RFP Manager works closely with subject matter experts across Sales, Operations, Product, Finance, and Marketing to translate technical and program knowledge into clear, persuasive proposal content, while also partnering with Corporate Leadership on win strategy and driving continuous improvement across the proposal process.

Job Description:

Core Responsibilities

  • Proposal Development & Writing

    • Create high-quality, customized responses to requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for quotes (RFQs), and requests for information (RFIs).

    • Edit content created by subject matter experts and partner with Marketing to improve and refine new content.

    • Develop, write, and proofread content tailored for different audiences — from novice to expert — and flexible for use across different markets and program implementations.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional subject matter experts and corporate personnel to develop and write technical and management content for written responses.

    • Edit content across all proposal documentation, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and integrity throughout.

    • Monitor workflow in Monday.com to ensure the RFP and government bid request process is consistently followed by all parties involved.

    Quality Assurance & Compliance

    • Ensure proposals meet established Elovate standards for content and style, and are compliant with Elovate Marketing corporate standards.

    • Serve as a final quality checkpoint, verifying that every proposal reflects Elovate's brand, accuracy, and professionalism before submission.

    Strategy & Stakeholder Collaboration

    • Collaborate with Corporate Leadership to develop a proposal win strategy and integrate that strategy throughout the proposal.

    • Maintain the database of competitive wins and losses, using insights to inform future proposal strategy and positioning.

    Training & Continuous Improvement

    • Provide training to Sales on RFP processes, timelines, and best practices.

    • Proactively identify areas of process improvement and lead efforts to drive a positive proposal experience for all stakeholders.

    • Assist with special projects and other duties as requested and assigned by management to support overall departmental efficiency.

    • 4+ years of experience in proposal management, technical writing, RFP response, or a related role, ideally within a B2B, government, or public sector environment.

    • Demonstrated ability to write, edit, and proofread clear, persuasive, and audience-appropriate content under tight deadlines.

raw.description:
GTM Manager / Head of GTM

Employment type: Full-time
Location: Remote

About our Client

Our client builds data generation and evaluation systems for Physical AI and robotics. We help technical teams turn complex data, model outputs, and evaluation workflows into usable systems for real-world AI and robotics development.

We are looking for a hands-on GTM Manager / Head of GTM to build our commercial strategy, win customers, and turn early traction into a repeatable revenue engine.

You will work directly with the founders and collaborate closely with product, research, and engineering. This role combines strategic go-to-market work with direct sales execution: identifying the right markets and accounts, opening conversations, understanding complex customer needs, shaping compelling commercial offers, and closing business.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and refine Miraxis’s ideal customer profile, priority segments, buyer personas, and target accounts across Physical AI and robotics.

  • Build and execute a go-to-market strategy covering positioning, customer acquisition, sales channels, and commercial partnerships.

  • Generate qualified pipeline through targeted outbound, founder networks, partnerships, industry events, and relevant inbound opportunities.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposals, negotiation, and closing.

  • Develop relationships with technical decision-makers, budget owners, and executive sponsors.

  • Understand customers’ data-generation and model-evaluation challenges, purchasing criteria, budgets, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value, differentiated messaging, and persuasive commercial materials.

  • Partner with technical teams to structure commercially viable pilots with measurable success criteria and a clear path to paid adoption.

  • Help develop pricing and packaging based on customer feedback, willingness to pay, and delivery economics.

  • Convert pilots and early engagements into paid contracts, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Identify partnerships that provide access to customers and create new revenue opportunities.

  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and communicate realistic forecasts, deal priorities, risks, and next steps.

  • Track conversion rates, sales-cycle length, deal value, and reasons for wins and losses.

  • Bring customer and market insights back to the product, research, and engineering teams.

  • Build repeatable sales processes and playbooks as Miraxis grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in B2B go-to-market, business development, or full-cycle sales for technical products or services.

  • A demonstrated record of personally generating pipeline and closing revenue.

  • Experience selling to technical buyers and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.

  • Strong discovery skills and the ability to connect customer challenges to a compelling value proposition.

  • Confidence leading commercial discussions, preparing proposals, negotiating terms, and moving opportunities toward a decision.

  • The ability to understand and credibly communicate technical concepts with support from subject-matter experts.

  • Experience developing market positioning, defining target segments, or testing customer-acquisition channels.

  • Strong commercial judgment and a disciplined approach to qualification, prioritization, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • High ownership and comfort building processes in an early-stage environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling solutions related to AI, robotics, data platforms, infrastructure, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or technical services.

  • A relevant network within robotics companies, AI labs, or enterprise AI teams.

  • Experience turning founder-led sales into a scalable and repeatable commercial process.

  • Experience structuring technical pilots or proof-of-concept engagements and converting them into paid contracts.

  • Familiarity with pricing and packaging for data, software, or technical services.

  • Experience developing revenue-generating partnerships.

  • Experience helping a new company or offering win its first customers or enter a new market.

What Success Looks Like

  • Miraxis has a clear ICP and positioning that resonates with technical and commercial buyers.

  • The company develops a growing, qualified pipeline that produces new paying customers.

  • Pilots have defined success criteria and commercial next steps, leading to paid adoption.

  • Revenue grows through new customer acquisition, renewals, and account expansion.

  • Forecasts accurately reflect deal progress and genuine buying signals.

  • Customer insights improve the company’s positioning, offers, and product direction.

  • Successful acquisition and sales approaches become repeatable playbooks.

Working at our Client

This is an opportunity to build the commercial function of a company working at the intersection of AI, robotics, data, and model evaluation. The right person will be commercially driven, intellectually curious, comfortable with technical products, and motivated by building the sales motion—not simply inheriting one.

You will have meaningful ownership, direct access to the founders, and the opportunity to influence both Miraxis’s revenue strategy and product direction.

If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a remote role.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Demonstrated personal lines underwriting leadership experience, with a strong understanding of underwriting operations, risk selection, portfolio management, agency relationships, and profit-driven decision making.

  • Proven ability to translate strategy into execution, leading teams through organizational change while driving accountability, engagement, and measurable business results.

  • Strong people leadership experience, including coaching leaders, building high-performing teams, developing talent, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Experience building and maintaining strategic relationships with agents, sales partners, and cross-functional stakeholders, with a customer-focused approach to influencing outcomes and enhancing the agent experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading large initiatives, modernization efforts, organizational design changes, or process improvements, coupled with an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and drive innovation.

Preferred:

  • Experience in agency, carrier, broker, or client-facing insurance environments, with the ability to influence partners, navigate complex relationships, and serve as a trusted underwriting consultant.

  • Experience leading teams through transformation, change management, or underwriting modernization initiatives.

Job Description Summary

Success on our team requires a blend of customer service skill and analytical prowess. Each account we work on is interesting and challenging. Satisfaction comes from finding solutions that provide the best coverage and give our partner agents a way to differentiate themselves from the competition. If you are adaptable, responsive, love customers and really want to make a difference, we want to hear from you!

As the Director, we'll count on you to drives profitable underwriting results through leadership, development and engagement for an assigned PL underwriting unit. You'll direct resources to deliver quality, timely underwriting decisions in support of the business, producers and members. You'll be key to proactively identify issues, ideas and make recommendations to profitably grow the business. You will also be responsible for planning, budgeting and reporting.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establishes research objectives and practice standards for the department. Ensures that methodologies and outcomes meet business and strategic objectives. Identifies research projects and may lead large research initiatives.

  • Leads identification of organizational needs that require analysis and directs department in completion. Sets expectations and standards of practice for analysis of underwriting rules and other processes. Ensures compliance to legal requirements and ensures alignment with organizational, business and strategic objectives.

  • Determines priorities and ensures adherence to workflow standards for the unit. Monitors and manages performance measurements to ensure effectiveness of the department's service delivery process. Effectively aligns organizational structure to drive business needs.

  • Responsible for directing the management of multi-line underwriting teams in support of personal lines products. Directs the alignment of underwriting execution based on underwriting strategy, objectives and goals. Provides recommendations to leadership regarding underwriting strategy and opportunity. Measures and manages underwriting effectiveness and overall quality assessment. Responsible for PL Underwriting decisions related to the agencies portfolio.

  • Translates strategic plans into organizational direction. Creates business plans, goals, budget and timelines aligned with company standards. Directs associates and provides performance management, salary planning and administration, organizational planning, hiring and placement, and disciplinary actions.

  • Consults with all levels of internal and external partners regarding underwriting policy and practice. Provides input into strategic and business plans and helps identify operational opportunities and efficiencies.

  • Communicates strategic direction, operational decisions and underwriting perspective to underwriting unit and internal and external partners.

  • Develops effective internal and external collaborative partnerships across all related functions, including: Claims, Sales, Product, IT, vendors, DOI, etc. to understand business developments and helps meet business needs.

  • Responsible for a high level of service to all customers and partners. Responds to escalated issues from internal and external partners. Drives customer service performance to established standards.

  • Determines and ensures delivery of training and development based on individual and department needs. Coaches, develops and provides feedback to associates. Directs development and delivery of education for internal and external partners and key organizational groups regarding underwriting practice, goals and strategies.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Sr. Underwriting Leadership. Direct reports include multiple PL Underwriting Managers for assigned states.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor's degree and pursuit of continued education desired. Masters in business or a related field is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of technical insurance coursework such as CPCU preferred.

Experience: Eight years underwriting, customer service or related experience. Significant business management and people leadership experience desired.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Detailed knowledge of personal lines insurance products, state regulations, management techniques, underwriting policies, procedures and best practices. Familiarity with other lines of business. Strong knowledge of company operations, financials, trend analysis and competitor data to drive underwriting performance. Ability to set strategic goals and priorities. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations. Ability to evaluate and recommend solutions regarding customer service, work processing, underwriting selection, and best practices compliance. Ability to reach a solution in situations where there may be multiple options or competing priorities. Strong analytical skills and drive for results. Skilled communicator with strong people leadership, engagement and development skills. Possess the ability to manage matrix relationships with regional, product and service center leadership; and to partner with sales and regional leadership in cooperative efforts to meet business objectives.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resource Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Occasional travel may be required to visit agencies or attend meetings. Extended or non-standard work hours as required to meet business need.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Gujarati
Type:Contract

Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents by finding publicly accessible Gujarati PDFs with multimodal elements like images, tables, or handwriting.
  • Annotate structure by identifying and bounding meaningful regions such as titles, headings, and figures, and assign component types and reading-order indices.
  • Record relationships by linking each region to its parent component, such as figures or tables.
  • Transcribe text faithfully in Gujarati script, including handwritten content, and flag illegible regions.
  • Capture page metadata including language, document type, source, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work, ensuring tasks are reviewed end to end by a second Gujarati expert.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Gujarati speaker with full command of the script.
  • Experience in annotation, transcription, translation, or regional-language data review.
  • High character-level accuracy.
  • Systematic approach to applying taxonomy across pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like multi-column newspapers and handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Experience with regional-language AI data annotation, labeling, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization, such as MTPE, subtitling, or OCR correction.
  • Document production experience in typesetting, copy-editing, or proofreading Gujarati-language material.
  • Knowledge of script and encoding, including Unicode normalization.

raw.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

As an Accountant, you will take end to end ownership of assigned accounting areas across operating costs, cash transactions, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed assets and intangible assets, including internally developed intangible assets. You will own the accounting, close and controls for your areas, while developing a strong understanding of the underlying data and processes and using AI and automation to improve quality, efficiency and scalability.

What you’ll work on:

  • Own key month end and quarter end accounting activities across operating costs, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed and intangible assets and leases, including journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, capitalisation and other period end adjustments.

  • Work with cash transactions and large accounting datasets, using analytical and AI enabled tools to identify exceptions, investigate unusual items and ensure transactions are complete, accurately classified and appropriately reflected in the financial statements.

  • Analyse balance sheet and P&L movements, get to the root cause of unexpected results and provide clear, evidence based commentary on key drivers.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the business activity, data and systems behind your accounting areas. Approach unfamiliar or non routine transactions with curiosity, research the accounting and form a point of view under relevant U.S. GAAP, escalating complex matters where appropriate.

  • Prepare supporting schedules, financial reporting and assigned SEC disclosures, and perform relevant ICFR and SOX controls with high quality documentation and testing readiness.

  • Take ownership of problems and drive them through to resolution, working across Finance and the wider business to improve upstream data, processes and controls rather than simply addressing issues at month end.

  • Support audit, tax and compliance requirements, proactively resolving issues and maintaining high quality supporting documentation.

  • Use AI and automation as part of how you work: experiment with new tools, challenge manual processes and identify, design and implement solutions that improve the speed, quality and scalability of accounting, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, governance and controls.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

We are looking for someone who combines strong accounting fundamentals with curiosity, judgement, ownership and a bias for action. You will enjoy solving problems where the answer is not immediately obvious, communicate a clear point of view and continually look for better ways to work.

Core Requirements:

  • 2+ years of relevant accounting or audit experience.

  • ACA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent professional accounting qualification, with.

  • Strong problem solving skills and curiosity, with the ability to work through ambiguity, investigate large or complex datasets, identify root causes and drive issues through to resolution.

  • High ownership, resilience and bias for action. You are comfortable taking initiative, making progress with incomplete information and learning quickly when faced with something unfamiliar.

  • High standards for accuracy and execution, with the ability to prioritise competing demands and deliver quality work at pace.

  • Clear, structured communication skills, with the ability to explain issues, articulate a point of view and collaborate effectively with Finance and non Finance stakeholders.

  • A strong AI and automation mindset, with hands on experience using AI, automation or data tools to solve problems or improve how work gets done. You are curious about emerging tools, willing to experiment and able to apply appropriate judgement, governance and controls.

  • Strong understanding of audit, ICFR and SOX requirements and experience working effectively with internal and external auditors.

  • Ability to learn quickly and collaborate constructively with a global, cross functional team across multiple time zones.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience in a leading professional services firm and/or a U.S. public company, including exposure to SEC reporting and SOX.

  • Experience in digital assets, payments, FinTech, technology or financial services industry. Understanding of blockchain technology and digital assets is a plus.

  • Experience in one or more areas such as operating costs, payroll and employee related costs, share based compensation, fixed assets, internally developed intangible assets or lease accounting

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion or another large scale ERP and practical experience with analytical, AI or automation tools.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

Known for seamlessly integrating these services using advanced technology, Ironmark stands as a nationwide, one-stop shop for integrated communications solutions and simplifying complexities across the marketing supply chain. For additional information, visit .

Job Summary

As Head of Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing Ironmark’s partnership strategy. You will identify and engage potential partners, negotiate collaboration terms, and manage ongoing relationships to drive partner sourced, partner influenced revenue and shared success. Your ability to build strong relationships, think strategically, and align partnerships with Ironmark’s goals will be instrumental in our continued growth.

Partnership Strategy & Development

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard affinity, channel, strategic, referral, and technology partners.

Revenue Growth & Pipeline Management

  • Build and manage a partner pipeline, driving recruitment, activation, expansion, and retention.
  • Lead account mapping, joint selling, pipeline reviews, and opportunity management with partner sales teams.
  • Drive revenue through partner-led, co-sell, and direct sales motions.

Partner Relationship Management

  • Serve as the executive point of contact for key partner relationships.
  • Develop partner-specific value propositions, enablement plans, and growth strategies.
  • Foster strong collaboration, trust, and alignment between Ironmark and partner organizations.
  • Manage partner performance and resource requirements to ensure mutual success.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Operations to execute joint go-to-market initiatives.
  • Develop partner enablement materials, training programs, and sales tools when applicable.
  • Manage channel conflict and ensure adherence to partner engagement rules and processes.

Performance & Market Engagement

  • Track and report on partner performance, revenue contribution, pipeline growth, and strategic objectives.
  • Present partnership progress and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Represent Ironmark at industry events, conferences, and partner meetings.

Key KPIs

  • Partner-sourced revenue
  • Partner-influenced revenue
  • Active strategic and reseller partners
  • Partner pipeline value
  • Partner-generated opportunities
  • Partner retention and growth
  • Partner onboarding and activation

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills include integrity, professional etiquette, and relationship management skills.
  • High-energy personality with excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills and ability to influence others internally and externally.
  • Strong leadership skills and ability to work both autonomously and as a team player.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify growth opportunities and align partnerships with business objectives.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for innovation and building mutually beneficial relationships.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess partnership performance and provide data-driven insights.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Problem solving disposition, curious by nature, with a constant desire to improve and achieve.
  • Ability to scope business requirements and document/communicate requirements.
  • Solid understanding of sales cycles and pipeline management.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines for fast execution.
  • Strong attention to detail and vigorous follow-up capabilities.
  • Must be able and willing to travel for partner meetings, conferences, and industry events, up to 30% of the time.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum Educational Requirement. Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field;
  • Minimum Experience: Proven experience in partnership management, business development, or related roles.
  • Experience managing partnership programs including affinity, co-sell, resell and referral relationships.
  • Track record of achieving and/or exceeding strategic partnership/partner relations objectives.
  • Business development experience with a strong hunter/prospecting mentality.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and CRM (salesforce.com/HubSpot) required.
  • Experience with tools including Gong and LinkedIn Sales Navigator strongly preferred.

  • Provides medical expertise in the operation of approved quality improvement and utilization management programs in accordance with regulatory, state, corporate, and accreditation requirements.
  • Assists the Chief Medical Director in the functioning of the physician committees including committee structure, processes, and membership.
  • Conduct regular rounds to assess and coordinate care for high-risk patients, collaborating with care management teams to optimize outcomes.
  • Collaborates effectively with clinical teams, network providers, appeals team, medical and pharmacy consultants for reviewing complex cases and medical necessity appeals.
  • Participates in provider network development and new market expansion as appropriate.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of physician education with respect to clinical issues and policies.
  • Identifies utilization review studies and evaluates adverse trends in utilization of medical services, unusual provider practice patterns, and adequacy of benefit/payment components.
  • Identifies clinical quality improvement studies to assist in reducing unwarranted variation in clinical practice in order to improve the quality and cost of care.
  • Interfaces with physicians and other providers in order to facilitate implementation of recommendations to providers that would improve utilization and health care quality.
  • Reviews claims involving complex, controversial, or unusual or new services in order to determine medical necessity and appropriate payment.
  • Develops alliances with the provider community through the development and implementation of the medical management programs.
  • As needed, may represent the business unit before various publics both locally and nationally on medical philosophy, policies, and related issues.
  • Represents the business unit at appropriate state committees and other ad hoc committees.
  • May be required to work weekends and holidays in support of business operations, as needed.

Education/Experience:

  • Medical Doctor or Doctor of Osteopathy.
  • Utilization Management experience and knowledge of quality accreditation standards preferred.
  • Actively practices medicine.
  • Course work in the areas of Health Administration, Health Financing, Insurance, and/or Personnel Management is advantageous.
  • Experience treating or managing care for a culturally diverse population preferred.

License/Certifications:

  • Board certification in a medical specialty recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialists or the American Osteopathic Association’s Department of Certifying Board Services.
  • Certification in Internal or Family Medicine, preferred.
  • Current state license as a MD or DO without restrictions, limitations, or sanctions from government programs.
Pay Range: $236,500.00 - $449,300.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to deliver exceptional support across phone, email, chat, and ticketing platforms.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and delivering professional, empathetic service in a fast-paced environment. You’ll serve as the first point of contact for customers, resolve issues efficiently, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure every interaction leaves a positive impression.

Responsibilities

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and support tickets.
  • Resolve customer issues professionally and efficiently.
  • Troubleshoot common concerns and escalate complex cases when needed.
  • Deliver outstanding customer experiences while meeting response time expectations.

Ticket & Case Management

  • Manage support requests using platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, or Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Prioritize tickets based on urgency and SLAs.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions.
  • Follow up on open cases until resolution.

Customer Experience

  • Communicate clearly and empathetically across all support channels.
  • De-escalate challenging customer situations professionally.
  • Capture customer feedback and identify recurring issues.
  • Maintain a customer-first approach in every interaction.

Knowledge Base & Team Collaboration

  • Update knowledge base articles, FAQs, and response templates.
  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes.
  • Collaborate with operations, product, billing, and technical teams to resolve escalated issues.
  • Ensure accurate handoffs and compliance with company policies.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–2 years of customer service, call center, or client support experience.
  • Experience using ticketing platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, or Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Comfortable working in high-volume support environments.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote work setup.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers.
  • Background in SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, finance, or service-based industries.
  • Experience working in KPI-driven support environments.
  • Familiarity with live chat platforms and support automation tools.
  • Multilingual communication skills.

What Success Looks Like

  • High First Contact Resolution (FCR) rates.
  • Strong CSAT and customer satisfaction scores.
  • Fast response and ticket resolution times.
  • Accurate documentation and ticket management.
  • Positive customer feedback and quality assurance results.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Practical Assessment
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

raw.excerpt: Who we are Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform.
raw.description:
Who we are

Our mission at Capacity is to help teams do their best work through our AI-powered support automation platform. Capacity provides everything you need to automate support and business processes in one powerful omni-channel platform.

We believe that each individual voice, perspective and background brings inherent value to enhance our product, serve our customers and generate more ideas to solve complex problems. By continuing to hire talented, driven and humble teammates, we have the opportunity to see Capacity become a premier brand enterprise SaaS platform.

Capacity has raised over $100 million dollars from over 150 investors, giving us the opportunity to make ambitious investments in our team and big bets on our future. Our total addressable market is enormous. Any company that wants to grow revenue, reduce costs, and improve customer and employee satisfaction is an opportunity for Capacity to shine.

Why this job is exciting

The role:

We are seeking elite IT Brand Ambassadors to represent CDW.com, providing high-skill, "white-glove" interactions that complete the digital buying experience.

This is not a traditional chat support role. Our Brand Ambassadors act as trusted technology advisors, helping customers navigate complex IT questions and identify the right solutions for their needs.

When customers initiate chat on , they are looking for expert guidance, not just answers. You will use your technical knowledge and experience to:

  • Understand customer challenges
  • Recommend the right products and solutions
  • Guide confident purchasing decisions

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the following:

  • IT Consultation: Provide expert recommendations across enterprise hardware, infrastructure, and IT solutions.
  • White-Glove Customer Experience: Deliver a premium support experience that prioritizes value, empathy, and technical expertise in every interaction.
  • Build Customer Loyalty: Create memorable interactions that deliver successful outcomes, and encourage continued engagement with CDW.
  • Product Advocacy: Confidently represent CDW's portfolio and navigate product comparisons.
  • Value-Driven Conversations: Use consultative communication to uncover needs and guide customers towards the right outcomes.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of IT industry experience. Background in large-scale corporate, healthcare, or institutional IT is highly beneficial.
  • Deep familiarity with top OS environments (Windows, macOS, Linux) and major hardware brands (Dell, HP, Cisco, Apple).
  • Exceptional ability to clearly communicate warmth and expertise through written conversations.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent conversations with professionalism and accuracy.

Tech Requirements:

  • Desktop or laptop (mobile/tablets not supported)
  • Stable high-speed internet (10mbps+) and reliable audio capability

You are motivated by:

  • Hustle: You inspire others to work as hard as you. You will find a way, no matter how hard the task is.
  • Ownership: You have an owner/builder mentality. You care about what you deliver and own your mistakes.
  • Proactivity: You don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do or what problems to solve. You are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Excellence: You set a high bar and surpass expectations. You hit your goals and ask for more.
  • Humility: You are not above any task in the organization and are willing to drop what you’re doing to help a teammate.

What you can expect from us

The team:

Capacity team members enjoy the opportunity and benefits of working at an artificial intelligence startup, but with leaders who’ve worked at places like Apple, Ebay, Visa, Answers.com, Oracle, Boeing, and many more world-class companies. The culture at Capacity encourages innovation, independent problem solving, and collaboration as we continue to mature our product in the ever-changing world of AI.

We provide:

  • Rate: $18–$22 per hour
  • Employment as a 1099 independent contractor with weekly payouts
  • Performance-based incentive rewards

Still unsure?

At Capacity we value more than just hard skills. Our goal is to build a holistic and diverse team. If you aren’t sure if you qualify, just apply! We will carefully consider your application and are always grateful for any time and effort invested in Capacity.

But wait, there’s more!

At Capacity we believe in more than just building amazing products and helping our customers. Although we are a remote workforce, we remember the neighborhood where we started. We still strive to elevate our community by furthering access to education and careers in the tech space. Our affiliated nonprofit, Create A Loop, brings rigorous computer science courses to underserved communities with little to no access to formal computer science education. There are many opportunities for our Capacity team members to serve and educate our Create A Loop students throughout the year.

Marketing Success Manager

Company: Ekwa Marketing Department: Client Success / Marketing Reports to: [Director of Client Success / Senior Management] Location: [Office / Remote] Employment type: Full-time

Position Summary

The Marketing Success Manager is the strategic partner and primary point of contact for our clients, owning both the relationship and the marketing outcomes that keep them with Ekwa long-term. Evolving from the traditional Client Success Manager role, this position blends account retention and relationship management with direct accountability for marketing performance and ROI.

Working with dental, medical, and other healthcare practice owners, the Marketing Success Manager ensures each client clearly understands the value Ekwa delivers, sees measurable results from their SEO, website, social media, and online advertising campaigns, and is confident in renewing and growing their partnership. The role bridges the client and Ekwa's specialist marketing teams to turn marketing activity into business growth for the client

Key Responsibilities

Client Success & Retention

  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for an assigned portfolio of client accounts, building trusted, long-term relationships.
  • Lead regular review meetings, and strategy sessions, ensuring expectations are set and met.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, and satisfaction; proactively identify and address churn risk.
  • Identify opportunities to expand accounts through additional services that genuinely benefit the client.

Marketing Strategy & Performance

  • Monitor campaign results across SEO, website, social media, reputation, and paid advertising, and drive optimization to improve ROI.
  • Interpret marketing data and analytics to make recommendations that grow client leads, new patients, and revenue.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends and best practices relevant to the healthcare/dental sector.

Reporting & Communication

  • Present clear, results-focused performance reports that connect marketing metrics to client business outcomes.
  • Communicate progress, wins, and next steps to clients in a way that is transparent and easy to understand.
  • Manage client expectations professionally, handling concerns with empathy and timely follow-through.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Act as the liaison between clients and Ekwa's specialist teams (SEO, web design, content, social media, advertising), ensuring deliverables align with client goals.
  • Brief internal teams on client objectives and feed back client priorities to keep work on track.
  • Collaborate with leadership on process improvements that raise the standard of client service and results.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 1+ years of experience in client success, account management, or digital marketing — preferably in an agency environment.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing channels: SEO, websites, social media, online reputation, and paid advertising.
  • Experience working with performance data and marketing analytics tools.
  • Experience serving healthcare, dental, or professional-services clients is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong relationship-building and client-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to translate marketing data into clear business value for non-marketing clients.
  • Strategic thinking combined with hands-on attention to detail.
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
  • Comfortable presenting results and leading client meetings with confidence.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively across departments.

STARTING PAY 50,000 CAD (Annual) + 10,000 CAD (Annual Bonus on performance)

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANYONE. We provide families an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Middle School Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Texas Virtual Academy of Hallsville (TVAH). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Texas Virtual Academy of Hallsville (TVAH) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

Special Education Teacher is the teacher of record for their students and provides instruction, support and guidance and manages the learning process focusing on self-contained and ALT students’ individual needs as defined by each student’s Individual Education Program (IEP). This role is also responsible for progress monitoring on goals and service logs as required in serving special education students and for all compliance documents required in serving self-contained and ALT students.

Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Collaborate with parents and colleagues to manage coarse goals, curriculum, and materials that enhance the learning experience;

  • Manager to create compliant IEP’s, progress reports and other state specific required special education documentation;

  • Participate and provide input for collaborative special education meetings such as annual IEP meetings;

  • Actively participate in Professional Learning Communities (or professional development);

  • Provide rich and engaging synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences for students;

  • Analyze student data to prescribe remediation and enrichment as needed;

  • Participate in data analysis meetings to monitor student growth;

  • Collect data and work samples to monitor student progress towards IEP goals and objectives;

  • Document all contact with parents, collaborations with general education teachers, and interventions with students;

  • Using provided resources to ensure accommodations and modifications for students with disabilities such as assistive technology, supplemental curriculum, and accessible text;

  • Provide special education services to students; support general education teachers and parents with student accommodations to promote the attainment of IEP goals;

  • Ensure inclusion and success of student in the general education classroom;

  • Provide personalizing learning for all students;

  • Demonstrate a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations;

  • Maintain grade book ensuring student academic integrity, provide input for student placement and promotion decisions, and alert administrators to concerns about student performance and progress;

  • Prepare students for high stakes standardized tests;

  • Understand that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner;

  • Support learning coaches/parents with student curricular and instructional issues, as well as basic troubleshooting in a virtual classroom environment that is in line with academy policies and procedures;

  • Support in-person student testing.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

OTHER REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work collaboratively with other teachers to interpret and produce numeric, tabular, and graphic representations of student data, and use it to drive instructional decisions

  • Receptive to receiving coaching on a regular basis with administrators

  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word; PowerPoint

  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms

  • Strong written/verbal communication skills

  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time to support in-person student testing, attend professional development or other travel as required by the school

  • Ability to clear required background check

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience working in with self-contained and ALT students in the proposed age group

  • Experience supporting adults and children in the use of technology

  • Experience teaching online (virtual) and/or in a brick-and-mortar environment

  • Experience with online learning platform

raw.excerpt: Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.
raw.description:
Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.

These few words shape everything we do at Packback from the smallest decision to the largest. Over the last decade since our company’s founding, our team has seen first-hand the power of giving students intentionally designed spaces in their learning experience to be autonomous and curious. We have also seen the incredible benefits of using AI technology to shorten feedback loops and help students revise their work before they submit.

Packback is a pedagogy partner that uses technology as a “means to an end” to shorten feedback loops for students and instructors, improve writing and critical thinking skills, and cultivate student-centered, trust-based educational learning environments.

Packback partners with 600+ higher education and K-12 institutions and is backed by growth equity firm PSG, with a platform proven to improve student writing confidence and cut instructor grading time by 30%.

About the role

We're looking for a VP of Sales to lead and scale Packback's sales organization as we grow our presence across higher education. This role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on leadership of the team responsible for new enterprise business — setting the overall direction for how Packback sells, structures, staffs, and compensates its sales function, while staying close enough to the field to coach Account Executives through institutional partnerships and faculty-driven adoption. You'll partner directly with the CEO and cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to set sales strategy, build the infrastructure to execute it, and expand our impact on campuses across the country. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

This is an opportunity for a senior sales leader who wants ownership over how a sales org is built, not just how it's run. You'll be accountable for revenue results, but you'll also shape org design, compensation strategy, and the long-term GTM architecture that determines how Packback scales.

Who is the ideal candidate?

  • You have experience leading enterprise sales organizations in EdTech, higher education, or another mission-driven B2B SaaS environment at the VP level or equivalent, and you've owned a sales org's structure and economics, not just its quota
  • You enjoy balancing strategy with execution — designing GTM motions and comp plans one day, joining a customer call or coaching a rep through a tough deal the next
  • You're comfortable operating as an executive partner to the CEO, translating market and pipeline data into strategy the leadership team and board can act on
  • You're motivated by building something meaningful and are excited by the opportunity to help colleges and universities improve student learning outcomes

What you'll do

  • Revenue Strategy & GTM Execution: Own the overarching sales strategy for the enterprise and B2C higher-ed business. Design and evolve go-to-market motions, organizational structure, staffing plans, and incentive structures in partnership with Finance and People to drive scalable growth.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives and front-line managers. Drive a high-performance culture through structured coaching on complex, multi-stakeholder deals—from discovery through close—and proactively recruit and onboard top sales talent. You’ll directly manage both front line managers as well as some enterprise sales representatives.
  • Sales Operations & Pipeline Management: Enforce forecast rigor and pipeline hygiene at the organizational level. Implement reliable processes, playbooks, and KPI tracking to ensure accurate forecasting and provide board-ready performance insights to the executive team.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Market Strategy: Drive deep alignment with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to optimize the end-to-end customer journey. Act as a market advocate, gathering insights from campus leaders and faculty to inform product direction and refine market narratives.

Requirements

  • 10+ years sales experience, including 3+ years leading multilayered teams (manager‑ and/or director‑level reports) in B2B SaaS or EdTech businesses
  • Demonstrated success selling complex solutions to higher education institutions or similarly complex organizations
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles while supporting higher-volume opportunities or multiple sales motions
  • Demonstrated success leading teams in account-based selling - navigate multi-stakeholder buying groups within each account, uncovering new sales opportunities and growing user adoption across the institution
  • Track record designing or redesigning quota, territory, or comp plans that improved attainment or efficiency
  • Strong coaching skills with a track record of improving individual and team performance
  • Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance metrics
  • Expert negotiator - experience navigating and negotiating MSAs, data‑privacy addenda, and multi‑year pricing frameworks
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence both internal stakeholders and executive-level customers
  • Familiarity with modern sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Salesloft, or similar platforms
  • Experience with consultative sales methodologies such as Challenger, MEDDIC, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • A genuine interest in education and a desire to help institutions improve outcomes for students
  • Ability to travel up to 25-35 % for (domestic U.S.) for campus visits, conferences, and executive sponsor meetings

Additional Information:

Sponsorship: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without the need for sponsorship. Packback does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Location: Currently we are only able to hire from these states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MD, MI, NJ, NC, NY, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI

Role Title: Research Engineer - Code Generation & Model Evaluation

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Research Engineers to participate in a project focused on code generation and model evaluation for a customer's initiative. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze, debug, and resolve issues across diverse codebases written in Python3, Java, Rust, C++, Go, or TypeScript.
  2. Contribute to the design and implementation of new features and enhancements for code generation workflows.
  3. Refactor and optimize codebases to improve performance, maintainability, and adaptability.
  4. Develop and review real-world coding tasks to evaluate AI model performance and accuracy.
  5. Author clear, actionable feedback and annotations to support model training and assessment.
  6. Collaborate with other open-source contributors and technical stakeholders to set technical direction and ensure robust outputs.
  7. Document technical decisions, best practices, and solutions to drive project transparency and knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Expertise in competitive programming and coding problem analysis.
  2. Expertise in at least one of: Python3, Java, Rust, C++, Go, or TypeScript, with solid knowledge of algorithms and data structures.
  3. Proven track record of open-source contributions or participation in collaborative software projects.
  4. Strong analytical abilities to interpret complex problem constraints and multiple solution paths.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical details clearly.
  6. Meticulous attention to detail in code validation and output consistency.
  7. Experience working independently in a remote, collaborative environment.
  8. Commitment to producing high-quality, well-documented code under tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

Prior experience as a problem setter, tester, or checker on major competitive programming platforms.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

  • Serve as a thought leader in the market and contribute to brand elevation via participation in industry forums, panels, and client advisory boards.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Contact Center/CX/Customer Experience/BPO/Business Process Services sales with a deep understanding of transformative outsourcing models.

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.


With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.


CURRENT EMPLOYEES: Please log into Workday Click Here to apply internally through the "Jobs Hub"


Job Description


Do you have at least 7 years of experience doing complex profee surgical coding?

Do you thrive on the challenge of diving into and researching proper codes to assign to a complex surgical procedure?

Then this position may be for you!

The Senior Professional Coder performs at an advanced level medical coding position and serves as an expert utilizing ICD-10 and CPT4 classification system coding to all diagnoses, treatments and procedures in all types of Hospital, Clinic and Ambulatory Surgical Center (ASC) locations at stated minimum performance levels. In addition, the Senior Professional Coder provides coding insight and guidance to clinical staff, Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI), Professional Coder 1 and Professional Coder II positions as well as Revenue Cycle leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assign and sequence all ICD-10; CPT 4; Healthcare Common Procedure Coding (HCPC) and modifier codes for services rendered accurately and completely

  • Reconcile correct coding edits and discrepancies prior to final coding

  • Maintain coding quality of 95% or higher while meeting established productivity requirements based on encounter type

  • Follows coding guidelines and legal requirements to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations

  • Identify trends in documentation deficiencies and communicates areas of improvement opportunities to leadership and/or providers

  • Acts as a key liaison for the physicians and clinical staff as it relates to coding and compliance

  • Interacts with physicians and other professional staff of documentation issues relating to coding data

  • Acts as a mentor to Coder I and Coder 2 staff

  • Provides system and workflow training to newly employed coders

  • Prepares and presents education in conjunction with the Revenue Integrity Professional Coding Educator

  • Primary contact for Revenue Cycle team throughout Shriners Hospitals for Children (SHC) system to assist with coding questions

  • Act as back up for Revenue Integrity Professional Coding Lead

Required Qualifications:

  • 7 years of coding experience in inpatient/outpatient professional surgery

  • Experience with Surgery Coding guidelines, E/M Coding Guidelines, CPT Coding, ICD-10, Modifiers, HCPCS and CCI edits

  • Pediatric, orthopedic and/or injury coding experience

  • Experience with education and presentations

  • Functional knowledge of Medical Terminology

  • Functional knowledge of professional coding practice standards

  • Functional knowledge of MS Office

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Current CCS-P (AHIMA) or CPC (AAPC)

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.
